+
+def lines_at(t, tp, col):
+    """Token t's 16 B ``col`` of line s: its byte in the slot (from line s's
+    chunk 2 s, a tile 1 KB: 8 tokens x 128 B), the DMA lane ``8 (t % 8) +
+    (col ^ sig)`` of chunk 2 s + t // 8."""
+    return (t // 8) * WAVES * TILEW * 4 + (t % 8) * LINE + 16 * (col ^ sig(t, tp))
+
+
+def dma_lane(lane):
+    """(token, 16 B cc) tail DMA lane ``lane`` carries (it lands at position
+    lane)."""
+    cc = lane // 16
+    return 4 * (lane % 4) + ((lane // 4) % 4 + 4 - cc) % 4, cc
+
+
+def vtr_lane(lane, wave, i, lines=True):
+    """This lane's byte in a block's (line wave // 2) of the 8 B it gives a
+    V^T transpose read of latent tile i (``tr_read``; tiles 2 n .. at + 2 n
+    TILEW): lane k of a 16 its half k % 2 of the 16 B 4 (wave % 2) + i of
+    token 4 g + k // 2 % 4 of tile k // 8 -> lane m: latent 64 wave + 16 i +
+    m, tokens 4 g .. of tiles 2 n, 2 n + 1."""
+    g, k = lane // 16, lane % 16
+    t = 4 * g + (k // 2) % 4
+    if not lines:
+        # the 64 B chunk layout: latent tile i at chunk wave
+        return (k // 8) * TILEW * 4 + 16 * kpos(t, i) + 8 * (k % 2)
+    col = 4 * (wave % 2) + i
+    return (k // 8) * TILEW * 4 + lines_at(t, k // 8, col) + 8 * (k % 2)
+
+
+def tr_read(addr):
+    """ds_read_b64_tr_b8 at LDS byte ``addr``: a lane m of 16 byte m % 8 of
+    the 8 B of lanes m // 8 + 2 e (byte e), as two dwords."""
+    p3 = llvm.inttoptr(ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<3>"), as_ir_value(fx.Int32(addr)))
+    return fx.Vector(rocdl.ds_read_tr8_b64(T.vec(2, T.i32), p3).result)
+
+
+def idx_load(c, b):
+    """The page indices of this lane's DMA tokens of block b's tile of this
+    wave (the tail's, lines' tokens lane // 8, + 8), clamped into the chunk
+    (a block past the last loads its rows)."""
+    t0 = c["c0"] + (b * WAVES + c["wave"]) * TILE
+    if const_expr(not c["lines"]):
+        return (ld_i32(c["args"]["pages"], c["p0"] + fx.min(t0 + c["dt"], c["last"])),)
+    return tuple(
+        ld_i32(c["args"]["pages"], c["p0"] + fx.min(t0 + t, c["last"]))
+        for t in (c["dt"], c["lane"] // 8, c["lane"] // 8 + 8)
+    )
+
+
+def dma_offs(c, idx):
+    """``k_dma``'s sources of ``idx_load``'s indices: the tail chunk's (16 B
+    dcc), line chunks' tokens lane // 8 and + 8 (their 16 B column
+    ``sig``-swizzled); bytes off the pool (``wide``: addresses)."""
+    cols = (
+        (c["dcc"] * 16, c["dcol"], c["dcol"] ^ 64)
+        if const_expr(c["lines"])
+        else (c["dcc"] * 16,)
+    )
+    if const_expr(c["wide"]):
+        return tuple(
+            c["args"]["kv"] + fx.Int64(i) * ENTRY + fx.Int64(col)
+            for i, col in zip(idx, cols)
+        )
+    return tuple(fx.Int32(i) * ENTRY + col for i, col in zip(idx, cols))
+
+
+def k_dma(c, b, offs, ps=None, tile=None):
+    """Block b's K tile of this wave (or ``tile``; ``dma_offs``) -> slot
+    b % 2: a DMA a chunk (64 lanes x 16 B: line s's 8 tokens, the tail's 16).
+    Inline asm: LLVM's own wait for an LDS DMA would hold this block's slot
+    reads for the next block's DMA too; ``vmwait`` / ``wait_dma`` are the only
+    waits."""
+    ps = range(KLOADS) if ps is None else ps
+    tile = c["wave"] if tile is None else tile
+    dst = c["ks_b"] + ((b % 2) * SLOT + tile * TILEW) * 4
+
+    def at(p):
+        # (offset, immediate): chunk 2 s + h line s of tokens 8 h ..
+        if const_expr(p == KLOADS - 1 or not c["lines"]):
+            return offs[0], CHUNK * p
+        return offs[1 + p % 2], LINE * (p // 2)
+
+    if const_expr(c["wide"]):
+        for p in ps:
+            o, imm = at(p)
+            lds_dma(o + imm, dst + p * WAVES * TILEW * 4)
+    else:
+        # a 32-bit offset off the pool's SGPR base, the line in the
+        # immediate (half the address VGPRs a DMA reads; the immediate
+        # offsets the LDS side too, M0 takes it back)
+        for p in ps:
+            o, imm = at(p)
+            llvm.inline_asm(
+                None,
+                [
+                    as_ir_value(o),
+                    as_ir_value(fx.Int64(c["args"]["kv"])),
+                    as_ir_value(uniform(dst + p * WAVES * TILEW * 4 - imm)),
+                ],
+                "s_mov_b32 m0, $2\n\ts_nop 0\n\t"
+                f"global_load_lds_dwordx4 $0, $1 offset:{imm}",
+                "v,s,s,~{m0},~{memory}",
+                has_side_effects=True,
+            )
+
+
+def lds_dma(src, dst):
+    """A global_load_lds_dwordx4: lane i's 16 B at ``src`` -> LDS byte
+    ``dst`` (uniform) + 16 i. (Every LDS DMA here an ``s_nop`` between its M0
+    write and the load: right after the write the load could read a stale M0,
+    the warp-specialized waves' K / index DMAs then landing in another slot:
+    nondeterministic outputs.)"""
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [as_ir_value(fx.Int64(src)), as_ir_value(uniform(dst))],
+        "s_mov_b32 m0, $1\n\ts_nop 0\n\tglobal_load_lds_dwordx4 $0, off",
+        "v,s,~{m0},~{memory}",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+    )
+
+
+@traced
+def idx_dma(c, b, t0=None, n=1):
+    """Block b's page indices of this wave's tile (or tiles t0 .. t0 + n) ->
+    its LDS index slot b % 2 (lanes 0 .. 16 n, token lane's): a DMA, so it
+    lands in order with the K DMAs (a load would make LLVM wait on every DMA
+    before it to read it)."""
+    t0 = c["wave"] if t0 is None else t0
+    if c["lane"] < n * TILE:
+        tok = c["c0"] + (b * WAVES + t0) * TILE + c["lane"]
+        src = c["args"]["pages"] + fx.Int64(c["p0"] + fx.min(tok, c["last"])) * 4
+        dst = c["xi_b"] + ((b % 2) * WAVES + t0) * TILE * 4
+        llvm.inline_asm(
+            None,
+            [as_ir_value(fx.Int64(src)), as_ir_value(uniform(dst))],
+            "s_mov_b32 m0, $1\n\ts_nop 0\n\tglobal_load_lds_dword $0, off",
+            "v,s,~{m0},~{memory}",
+            has_side_effects=True,
+        )
+
+
+def idx_lds(c, b):
+    """This lane's DMA tokens' page indices of block b (``idx_dma``'s; as
+    ``idx_load``)."""
+    xb = c["xi"] + ((b % 2) * WAVES + c["wave"]) * TILE
+    if const_expr(not c["lines"]):
+        return (fx.ptr_load(xb + c["dt"]),)
+    return (
+        fx.ptr_load(xb + c["dt"]),
+        fx.ptr_load(xb + c["lane"] // 8),
+        fx.ptr_load(xb + c["lane"] // 8 + 8),
+    )
+
+
+def vmwait(n):
+    """s_waitcnt vmcnt(n): at most n of this wave's loads / DMAs in flight
+    (they land in order)."""
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None, [], f"s_waitcnt vmcnt({n})", "~{memory}", has_side_effects=True
+    )
+
+
+def wait_dma():
+    """This wave's DMAs (and loads) landed; the CTA's after the barrier."""
+    llvm.inline_asm(None, [], "s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)", "", has_side_effects=True)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+def xm_row(c, r, row):
+    """The waves' values of row ``row`` of row tile r in xm
+    (``[r][row][wave]``: two b128 reads)."""
+    v = [
+        fx.Vector(
+            fx.ptr_load(
+                c["xm"] + (r * TILE + row) * WAVES + 4 * k,
+                result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Float32),
+            )
+        )
+        for k in range(2)
+    ]
+    return [v[w // 4][w % 4] for w in range(WAVES)]
+
+
+def v_reads(c, b, dma):
+    """V^T of the slot's block b by transpose reads, the A of a 16x16x128 fp8
+    MFMA a latent tile i: a lane's 32 B tile w's tokens 4 g .. at 4 w (P's
+    order); ``dma`` the hook ``v<i>``'s K chunks before tile i's reads."""
+    vw = (c["wave"] // 2) * 2 if const_expr(c["lines"]) else c["wave"]
+    vt = c["ks_b"] + ((b % 2) * SLOT + vw * WAVES * TILEW) * 4
+    va = []
+    for i in range_constexpr(4):
+        dma(f"v{i}")
+        tr = [tr_read(vt + c["vtr"][i] + n * 2 * TILEW * 4) for n in range(4)]
+        va.append(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                [tr[n][e] for n in range(4) for e in range(2)], fx.Int32
+            )
+        )
+    return va
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_block(c, b, st, dma, kwait, masked):
+    """One block (its K in slot b % 2) into the running (m, l, O) of each of
+    the CTA's row tiles (K and V^T read once for all); ``dma(hook)``
+    issues the hook's of block b + 1's K chunks (``DMA``), ``kwait(p)`` waits
+    for this wave's chunk p of block b; ``masked``: a block with a token past
+    the chunk or a row's causal bound (else every score kept)."""
+    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    row = lane % TILE
+    rt = c["rt"]
+    m_run, l_run, o = st
+    kt = c["ks"] + (b % 2) * SLOT + wave * TILEW
+
+    def kld(at):
+        return fx.Vector(
+            fx.ptr_load(kt + at, result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32))
+        )
+
+    def kstep(s):
+        """Step s's K words: line s's 16 B columns 2 g, 2 g + 1 (chunks 2 s,
+        2 s + 1; the tail: chunk 8's g), once landed."""
+        if const_expr(not c["lines"]):
+            ats = [
+                p * WAVES * TILEW + c["qpos"][2]
+                for p in ([2 * s, 2 * s + 1] if s < QSTEPS else [2 * s])
+            ]
+        else:
+            ats = (
+                [2 * s * WAVES * TILEW + c["qpos"][k] for k in range(2)]
+                if s < QSTEPS
+                else [2 * s * WAVES * TILEW + c["qpos"][2]]
+            )
+        kwait(2 * s + 1 if s < QSTEPS else 2 * s)
+        return [w for at in ats for w in (lambda v: [v[e] for e in range(4)])(kld(at))]
+
+    # S^T: token (4 g + j) x row (lane % 16), a tile r of rows each; fp8 K
+    # straight into the MFMA against Q's hi and lo (``q_parts``), a step's K
+    # read during the step before (``sched_barrier``: no hoisting past it)
+    acc = [fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32) for _ in range(rt)]
+    nxt = kstep(0)
+    for s in range_constexpr(QSTEPS + 1):
+        words = nxt
+        if const_expr(s < QSTEPS):
+            nxt = kstep(s + 1)
+            ka = fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32)
+            for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+                for h in range_constexpr(2):
+                    acc[r] = mfma_f8(ka, c["q"][r][2 * s + h], acc[r])
+        else:
+            # the tail: chunk 8 twice against its hi | lo (from ``qt``: in
+            # VGPRs they'd spill, the reload a stall a block)
+            ka = fx.Vector.from_elements(words + words, fx.Int32)
+            for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+                qb = c["qt"] + (r * TILE + row) * (2 * CHUNK // 4) + 4 * (lane // 16)
+                qtl = [
+                    fx.Vector(
+                        fx.ptr_load(
+                            qb + h * CHUNK // 4,
+                            result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                        )
+                    )
+                    for h in range(2)
+                ]
+                qtv = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                    [qtl[h][e] for h in range(2) for e in range(4)], fx.Int32
+                )
+                acc[r] = mfma_f8(ka, qtv, acc[r])
+        dma(f"q{s}")
+        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+    # scores (log2 units: acc qscale, qscale > 0, so the max on acc's),
+    # causal + chunk mask
+    sc = [[acc[r][j] for j in range(4)] for r in range(rt)]
+    if const_expr(masked):
+        t0 = c["c0"] + (b * WAVES + wave) * TILE + 4 * (lane // TILE)
+        ok = [(t0 + j <= c["last"]) & (t0 + j <= c["bound"]) for j in range(4)]
+        ninf = fx.Float32(float("-inf"))
+        sc = [[ok[j].select(sc[r][j], ninf) for j in range(4)] for r in range(rt)]
+    mx = [
+        fx.max(fx.max(sc[r][0], sc[r][1]), fx.max(sc[r][2], sc[r][3]))
+        for r in range(rt)
+    ]
+    if const_expr(rt == 2):
+        # the two row tiles' halves in one swap: lanes 32 r .. row tile r's
+        x, y = permlane_swap(32, mx[0].bitcast(fx.Int32), mx[1].bitcast(fx.Int32))
+        m2 = butterfly(
+            fx.max(x.bitcast(fx.Float32), y.bitcast(fx.Float32)), (16,), fx.max
+        )
+        if lane % 32 < TILE:
+            fx.ptr_store(m2, c["xm"] + ((lane // 32) * TILE + row) * WAVES + wave)
+    else:
+        for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+            m1 = butterfly(mx[r], (32, 16), fx.max)
+            if lane < TILE:
+                fx.ptr_store(m1, c["xm"] + (r * TILE + row) * WAVES + wave)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    stamp(c, 2 + 4 * b + 1)
+    dma("p")
+    mb = []
+    for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+        xw = xm_row(c, r, row)
+        mb.append(
+            fx.max(
+                fx.max(fx.max(xw[0], xw[1]), fx.max(xw[2], xw[3])),
+                fx.max(fx.max(xw[4], xw[5]), fx.max(xw[6], xw[7])),
+            )
+            * c["qscale"][r]
+        )
+    m_new, alpha = [], []
+    for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+        m_new.append(fx.max(m_run[r], mb[r]))
+        alpha.append(hw_exp2(m_run[r] - m_new[r]))
+        # p 2^PLOG (l, O alike: the normalization undoes it)
+        nmp = fx.Float32(PLOG) - m_new[r]
+        p = [hw_exp2(fmath.fma(sc[r][j], c["qscale"][r], nmp)) for j in range(4)]
+        # l a lane's (its 4 tokens'), summed over the lanes at the end
+        # (pairs, as the split's: no shuffling moves)
+        pp = [
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(p[2 * k : 2 * k + 2], fx.Float32) for k in range(2)
+        ]
+        ps = pp[0] + pp[1]
+        l_run[r] = l_run[r] * alpha[r] + (ps[0] + ps[1])
+        # [r][hi, lo][tile // 4][lane][tile % 4]: a lane's 8 tiles two b128
+        pw = fp8_split4(p)
+        for h in range_constexpr(2):
+            fx.ptr_store(pw[h], c["xp"] + xp_at(r, h, wave // 4, lane) + wave % 4)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    stamp(c, 2 + 4 * b + 2)
+    # O^T += V^T P^T, the block an MFMA a (latent tile i, P part) (k: tile
+    # w's tokens 4 g .. at 4 w): latents 64 wave + 16 i + 4 g + j, chunk p =
+    # wave of the slot; o[4 r + i] row tile r's (P's hi and lo into it alike)
+    o = [
+        fx.Vector.from_elements(
+            [o[4 * r + i][j] * alpha[r] for j in range(4)], fx.Float32
+        )
+        for r in range(rt)
+        for i in range(4)
+    ]
+    va = v_reads(c, b, dma)
+    for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+        for h in range_constexpr(2):
+            pb = [
+                fx.Vector(
+                    fx.ptr_load(
+                        c["xp"] + xp_at(r, h, k, lane),
+                        result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                    )
+                )
+                for k in range(2)
+            ]
+            pv = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                [pb[w // 4][w % 4] for w in range(WAVES)], fx.Int32
+            )
+            dma(f"m{2 * r + h}")
+            for i in range_constexpr(4):
+                o[4 * r + i] = mfma_f8(va[i], pv, o[4 * r + i])
+    # the PV MFMAs before the next block's index wait (in order, it would
+    # hold them for this block's DMAs)
+    rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+    stamp(c, 2 + 4 * b + 3)
+    return m_new, l_run, o
+
+
+def block(c, b, st, masked):
+    """Block b (``stage_block``) behind the top barrier, its DMA hooks."""
+    rt = c["rt"]
+    # the slot block b + 1's DMA takes was the last block's (its PV
+    # over): the waves in step; block b's own K waits a chunk
+    gpu.barrier()
+    stamp(c, 2 + 4 * b)
+    idx_dma(c, b + 2)
+    # block b + 1's indices landed (newer: block b's 9 chunks, b + 2's
+    # indices)
+    vmwait(KLOADS + 1)
+    i1 = dma_offs(c, idx_lds(c, b + 1))
+    # in flight (oldest first): block b's K chunks, block b + 2's
+    # indices, then block b + 1's chunks as sent
+    sent = [0]
+
+    def kwait(p):
+        # newer than chunk p: chunks p + 1 .., the indices, the sent
+        vmwait(KLOADS - p + sent[0])
+
+    def dma(hook):
+        n = DMA[min(rt, 2)].get(hook, 0)
+        if const_expr(c["dbg"] != 1 and n > 0):
+            # pinned where the schedule puts it
+            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+            k_dma(c, b + 1, i1, range(sent[0], sent[0] + n))
+            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+        sent[0] += n
+
+    return stage_block(c, b, st, dma, kwait, masked)
+
+
+@traced
+def run(c):
+    """The blocks (block 0's DMA and block 1's indices issued) and the
+    partial's stores."""
+    lane, wave, g = c["lane"], c["wave"], c["lane"] // TILE
+    row = lane % TILE
+    rt = c["rt"]
+    m_run = [fx.Float32(NEG) for _ in range(rt)]
+    l_run = [fx.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(rt)]
+    o = [fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32) for _ in range(4 * rt)]
+    # K a block ahead (slot b % 2), the indices two (``xi``, DMA'd too)
+    stamp(c, 1)
+    # the blocks every score of is kept (their last token at most the
+    # chunk's and position 0's bound) unmasked, then the rest
+    b = fx.Int32(0)
+    while b < c["nfull"]:
+        m_run, l_run, o = block(c, b, (m_run, l_run, o), False)
+        b = b + 1
+    while b < c["nblk"]:
+        m_run, l_run, o = block(c, b, (m_run, l_run, o), True)
+        b = b + 1
+    # l over the lanes, then the waves (each its tiles' sum, at the common
+    # running max)
+    l_run = [butterfly(l_run[r], (32, 16)) for r in range(rt)]
+    if lane < TILE:
+        for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+            fx.ptr_store(l_run[r], c["xm"] + (r * TILE + row) * WAVES + wave)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    a = c["args"]
+    for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+        xw = xm_row(c, r, row)
+        lt = xw[0]
+        for w in range_constexpr(1, WAVES):
+            lt = lt + xw[w]
+        empty = lt == fx.Float32(0.0)
+        inv = empty.select(fx.Float32(0.0), hw_rcp(lt) * c["vscale"])
+        # lane: latents 64 wave + 16 i + 4 g + j of its row; tiles 2 n,
+        # 2 n + 1 traded over the 16-lane rows (``permlane_swap``): an even
+        # g its 8 latents 4 g .. of tile 2 n, an odd g 4 (g - 1) .. of 2 n + 1
+        th = (c["split"] * c["S"] + c["t"]) * NH + c["h"][r]
+        pk = [
+            [
+                bf16_pair(o[4 * r + i][j] * inv, o[4 * r + i][j + 1] * inv).bitcast(
+                    fx.Int32
+                )
+                for j in (0, 2)
+            ]
+            for i in range(4)
+        ]
+        for n in range_constexpr(2):
+            sw = [permlane_swap(16, pk[2 * n][e], pk[2 * n + 1][e]) for e in range(2)]
+            lat = wave * VCOLS + 16 * (2 * n + g % 2) + 4 * (g - g % 2)
+            v = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                [sw[0][0], sw[1][0], sw[0][1], sw[1][1]], fx.Int32
+            )
+            # stamps: split 0's rows hold them; the rest still store (PV live)
+            live = (c["split"] > 0) if const_expr(c["stamps"]) else True
+            if const_expr(c["dbg"] != 2):  # noqa: SIM102
+                if live:
+                    bo.buffer_store(
+                        v,
+                        rsrc(a["part_o"]),
+                        (th * KVL + lat) // 2,
+                        cache_modifier=c["cm"],
+                    )
+        if (wave == 0) & (lane < TILE):
+            lse = m_run[r] + (hw_log2(lt) - fx.Float32(PLOG))
+            lse = empty.select(fx.Float32(float("-inf")), lse * fx.Float32(LN2))
+            bo.buffer_store(lse, rsrc(a["part_lse"]), th, cache_modifier=c["cm"])
+    stamp(c, 63)
+
+
+def chunk_dma(c, src, imm, dst):
+    """One chunk DMA (``k_dma``'s): ``src`` + ``imm`` (an offset off the pool,
+    or ``wide`` an address) -> LDS byte ``dst`` (uniform; lane i its 16 B at
+    + 16 i)."""
+    if const_expr(c["wide"]):
+        lds_dma(src + imm, dst)
+    else:
+        llvm.inline_asm(
+            None,
+            [
+                as_ir_value(src),
+                as_ir_value(fx.Int64(c["args"]["kv"])),
+                as_ir_value(uniform(dst - imm)),
+            ],
+            "s_mov_b32 m0, $2\n\ts_nop 0\n\t"
+            f"global_load_lds_dwordx4 $0, $1 offset:{imm}",
+            "v,s,s,~{m0},~{memory}",
+            has_side_effects=True,
+        )
+
+
+def ws_offs(c, b, t):
+    """This lane's DMA source of tile t of block b (``dma_offs``, its index
+    from the index slot)."""
+    return dma_offs(
+        c, (fx.ptr_load(c["xi"] + ((b % 2) * WAVES + t) * TILE + c["dt"]),)
+    )[0]
+
+
+def ws_dmas(c, bb, ps, hooks=("all",)):
+    """This wave's DMA hook of block bb's tile's chunks ``ps`` (``k_dma``'s),
+    spread over ``hooks`` (the first ones one more)."""
+    if const_expr(c["dbg"] == 1):
+        return lambda hook: None
+    offs = (ws_offs(c, bb, c["wave"]),)
+    ps = list(ps)
+    nh = len(hooks)
+    cut = [0] + [len(ps) - (len(ps) * (nh - i)) // nh for i in range(1, nh + 1)]
+    at = {h: ps[cut[i] : cut[i + 1]] for i, h in enumerate(hooks)}
+
+    def dma(hook):
+        if const_expr(len(at.get(hook, [])) > 0):
+            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+            k_dma(c, bb, offs, at[hook])
+            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+
+    return dma
+
+
+def ws_vtile(c, b, i):
+    """V^T latent tile i (of 8: 128 v + 16 i ..) of the slot's block b
+    (``v_reads``'): 8 dwords."""
+    vt = c["vb"] + ((b % 2) * SLOT + (i // 4) * WAVES * TILEW) * 4 + c["vtr"][i % 4]
+    tr = [tr_read(vt + n * 2 * TILEW * 4) for n in range(4)]
+    return fx.Vector.from_elements(
+        [tr[n][e] for n in range(4) for e in range(2)], fx.Int32
+    )
+
+
+@traced
+def ws_qk_block(c, b, st, masked):
+    """QK wave step b: S of block b's tiles 2 w, 2 w + 1 (``stage_block``'s
+    QK), the max over the QK waves (B1), block b + 2's tile DMA'd, P(b) -> xp,
+    alpha -> xm (B2: block b + 1's landed)."""
+    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    row = lane % TILE
+    g = lane // TILE
+    rt = c["rt"]
+    m_run, l_run = st
+    # block b + 1's chunks WS_K1.. over the QK steps, then block b + 3's
+    # indices (its slot's read by then)
+    early = ws_dmas(c, b + 1, range(WS_K1, KLOADS), [f"k{s}" for s in range(QSTEPS)])
+    slot = c["ks"] + (b % 2) * SLOT
+    kt = slot + 2 * wave * TILEW + c["qpos"][2]
+
+    def kstep(s):
+        ps = [2 * s, 2 * s + 1] if s < QSTEPS else [2 * s]
+        return [
+            [
+                v[e]
+                for p in ps
+                for v in [
+                    fx.Vector(
+                        fx.ptr_load(
+                            kt + p * WAVES * TILEW + j * TILEW,
+                            result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                        )
+                    )
+                ]
+                for e in range(4)
+            ]
+            for j in range(2)
+        ]
+
+    acc = [[fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32) for _ in range(rt)] for _ in range(2)]
+    nxt = kstep(0)
+    for s in range_constexpr(QSTEPS + 1):
+        words = nxt
+        if const_expr(s < QSTEPS):
+            nxt = kstep(s + 1)
+            early(f"k{s}")
+            if const_expr(s == QSTEPS - 1):
+                idx_dma(c, b + 3)
+            for j in range_constexpr(2):
+                ka = fx.Vector.from_elements(words[j], fx.Int32)
+                for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+                    for h in range_constexpr(2):
+                        acc[j][r] = mfma_f8(ka, c["q"][r][2 * s + h], acc[j][r])
+        else:
+            for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+                qb = c["qt"] + (r * TILE + row) * (2 * CHUNK // 4) + 4 * g
+                qtl = [
+                    fx.Vector(
+                        fx.ptr_load(
+                            qb + h * CHUNK // 4,
+                            result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                        )
+                    )
+                    for h in range_constexpr(2)
+                ]
+                qtv = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                    [qtl[h][e] for h in range(2) for e in range(4)], fx.Int32
+                )
+                for j in range_constexpr(2):
+                    ka = fx.Vector.from_elements(words[j] + words[j], fx.Int32)
+                    acc[j][r] = mfma_f8(ka, qtv, acc[j][r])
+        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+    sc = [[[acc[j][r][e] for e in range(4)] for r in range(rt)] for j in range(2)]
+    if const_expr(masked):
+        ninf = fx.Float32(float("-inf"))
+        for j in range_constexpr(2):
+            t0 = c["c0"] + (b * WAVES + 2 * wave + j) * TILE + 4 * g
+            ok = [(t0 + e <= c["last"]) & (t0 + e <= c["bound"]) for e in range(4)]
+            sc[j] = [
+                [ok[e].select(sc[j][r][e], ninf) for e in range(4)] for r in range(rt)
+            ]
+    mx = []
+    for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+        m4 = [fx.max(sc[0][r][e], sc[1][r][e]) for e in range(4)]
+        mx.append(fx.max(fx.max(m4[0], m4[1]), fx.max(m4[2], m4[3])))
+    x, y = permlane_swap(32, mx[0].bitcast(fx.Int32), mx[1].bitcast(fx.Int32))
+    m2 = butterfly(fx.max(x.bitcast(fx.Float32), y.bitcast(fx.Float32)), (16,), fx.max)
+    if lane % 32 < TILE:
+        fx.ptr_store(m2, c["xm"] + ((lane // 32) * TILE + row) * WAVES + wave)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    ws_dmas(c, b + 2, range(WS_K1))("all")
+    m_new, alpha = [], []
+    for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+        xw = fx.Vector(
+            fx.ptr_load(
+                c["xm"] + (r * TILE + row) * WAVES,
+                result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Float32),
+            )
+        )
+        mb = fx.max(fx.max(xw[0], xw[1]), fx.max(xw[2], xw[3])) * c["qscale"][r]
+        m_new.append(fx.max(m_run[r], mb))
+        alpha.append(hw_exp2(m_run[r] - m_new[r]))
+        nmp = fx.Float32(PLOG) - m_new[r]
+        lsum = None
+        for j in range_constexpr(2):
+            p = [hw_exp2(fmath.fma(sc[j][r][e], c["qscale"][r], nmp)) for e in range(4)]
+            pp = [
+                fx.Vector.from_elements(p[2 * k : 2 * k + 2], fx.Float32)
+                for k in range(2)
+            ]
+            lsum = pp[0] + pp[1] if lsum is None else lsum + pp[0] + pp[1]
+            pw = fp8_split4(p)
+            t = 2 * wave + j
+            for h in range_constexpr(2):
+                fx.ptr_store(pw[h], c["xp"] + xp_at(r, h, t // 4, lane) + t % 4)
+        assert lsum is not None
+        l_run[r] = l_run[r] * alpha[r] + (lsum[0] + lsum[1])
+    if (wave == 0) & (lane < TILE):
+        for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+            fx.ptr_store(alpha[r], c["xm"] + (r * TILE + row) * WAVES + QKW)
+    vmwait(0 if const_expr(c["dbg"] == 1) else WS_K1)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    return m_new, l_run
+
+
+@traced
+def ws_qk(c):
+    """The QK waves' steps (``ws_qk_block``), the last block's PV's barriers,
+    then the l over the waves and the LSE."""
+    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    row = lane % TILE
+    rt = c["rt"]
+    m_run = [fx.Float32(NEG) for _ in range(rt)]
+    l_run = [fx.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(rt)]
+    # block 1's tile's chunks ..WS_K1 (the rest step 0's)
+    ws_dmas(c, 1, range(WS_K1))("all")
+    b = fx.Int32(0)
+    while b < c["nfull"]:
+        m_run, l_run = ws_qk_block(c, b, (m_run, l_run), False)
+        b = b + 1
+    while b < c["nblk"]:
+        m_run, l_run = ws_qk_block(c, b, (m_run, l_run), True)
+        b = b + 1
+    vmwait(0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    gpu.barrier()
+    l_run = [butterfly(l_run[r], (32, 16)) for r in range(rt)]
+    if lane < TILE:
+        for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+            fx.ptr_store(l_run[r], c["xm"] + (r * TILE + row) * WAVES + wave)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if (wave == 0) & (lane < TILE):
+        for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+            lt = ws_l(c, r, row)
+            empty = lt == fx.Float32(0.0)
+            th = (c["split"] * c["S"] + c["t"]) * NH + c["h"][r]
+            lse = m_run[r] + (hw_log2(lt) - fx.Float32(PLOG))
+            lse = empty.select(fx.Float32(float("-inf")), lse * fx.Float32(LN2))
+            bo.buffer_store(
+                lse, rsrc(c["args"]["part_lse"]), th, cache_modifier=c["cm"]
+            )
+
+
+def ws_l(c, r, row):
+    """Row ``row`` of row tile r's l: the QK waves' (xm) summed."""
+    xw = fx.Vector(
+        fx.ptr_load(
+            c["xm"] + (r * TILE + row) * WAVES,
+            result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Float32),
+        )
+    )
+    return (xw[0] + xw[1]) + (xw[2] + xw[3])
+
+
+@traced
+def ws_pv_block(c, b, st):
+    """PV wave step b: O += V^T P^T of block b - 1 (its V^T ``va`` read in
+    step b - 1, P from xp, alpha from xm), B1 after ``WS_B1``
+    latent tiles, V^T(b) read before it (block b's slot then free); after B1
+    block b + 2's chunks DMA'd (block b + 1's landed by B2)."""
+    lane = c["lane"]
+    row = lane % TILE
+    rt = c["rt"]
+    o, va = st
+    early = ws_dmas(c, b + 1, range(WS_K1, KLOADS), [f"m{i}" for i in range(WS_B1)])
+    xp = c["xp"]
+    al = [fx.ptr_load(c["xm"] + (r * TILE + row) * WAVES + QKW) for r in range(rt)]
+    pv = []
+    for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+        for h in range_constexpr(2):
+            pb = [
+                fx.Vector(
+                    fx.ptr_load(
+                        xp + xp_at(r, h, k, lane),
+                        result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                    )
+                )
+                for k in range(2)
+            ]
+            pv.append(
+                fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                    [pb[w // 4][w % 4] for w in range(WAVES)], fx.Int32
+                )
+            )
+    o = [
+        fx.Vector.from_elements([o[8 * r + i][j] * al[r] for j in range(4)], fx.Float32)
+        for r in range(rt)
+        for i in range(8)
+    ]
+    nva = []
+    dma = None
+    for i in range_constexpr(8):
+        if const_expr(i == WS_B1):
+            nva += [ws_vtile(c, b, k) for k in range(WS_B1, 8)]
+            idx_dma(c, b + 3)
+            gpu.barrier()
+            dma = ws_dmas(c, b + 2, range(WS_K1), [f"m{k}" for k in range(WS_B1, 8)])
+        for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+            for h in range_constexpr(2):
+                o[8 * r + i] = mfma_f8(va[i], pv[2 * r + h], o[8 * r + i])
+        if const_expr(i < WS_B1):
+            nva.append(ws_vtile(c, b, i))
+            early(f"m{i}")
+        else:
+            assert dma is not None
+            dma(f"m{i}")
+    if const_expr(WS_B1 >= 8):
+        idx_dma(c, b + 3)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        ws_dmas(c, b + 2, range(WS_K1))("all")
+    vmwait(0 if const_expr(c["dbg"] == 1) else WS_K1)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    return o, nva
+
+
+@traced
+def ws_pv(c):
+    """The PV waves' steps: step 0 V^T(0) and block 1's DMA, then
+    ``ws_pv_block`` a block (one behind the QK waves), then o = O / l."""
+    lane, wave, g = c["lane"], c["wave"], c["lane"] // TILE
+    row = lane % TILE
+    rt = c["rt"]
+    o = [fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32) for _ in range(8 * rt)]
+    # step 0: block 1 (landed by B2), block 3's indices (after block 1's
+    # read theirs: the slot's), V^T(0), block 2 after B1
+    ws_dmas(c, 1, range(KLOADS))("all")
+    idx_dma(c, 3)
+    va = [ws_vtile(c, 0, i) for i in range(8)]
+    gpu.barrier()
+    ws_dmas(c, 2, range(WS_K1))("all")
+    vmwait(0 if const_expr(c["dbg"] == 1) else WS_K1)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    b = fx.Int32(1)
+    while b < c["nblk"] + 1:
+        o, va = ws_pv_block(c, b, (o, va))
+        b = b + 1
+    # the DMAs past the last block (clamped) land before the CTA's LDS goes
+    vmwait(0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    a = c["args"]
+    v = wave - QKW
+    for r in range_constexpr(rt):
+        lt = ws_l(c, r, row)
+        empty = lt == fx.Float32(0.0)
+        inv = empty.select(fx.Float32(0.0), hw_rcp(lt) * c["vscale"])
+        th = (c["split"] * c["S"] + c["t"]) * NH + c["h"][r]
+        for hf in range_constexpr(2):
+            pk = [
+                [
+                    bf16_pair(
+                        o[8 * r + 4 * hf + i][j] * inv,
+                        o[8 * r + 4 * hf + i][j + 1] * inv,
+                    ).bitcast(fx.Int32)
+                    for j in (0, 2)
+                ]
+                for i in range_constexpr(4)
+            ]
+            for n in range_constexpr(2):
+                sw = [
+                    permlane_swap(16, pk[2 * n][e], pk[2 * n + 1][e]) for e in range(2)
+                ]
+                lat = (2 * v + hf) * VCOLS + 16 * (2 * n + g % 2) + 4 * (g - g % 2)
+                vv = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                    [sw[0][0], sw[1][0], sw[0][1], sw[1][1]], fx.Int32
+                )
+                if const_expr(c["dbg"] != 2):
+                    bo.buffer_store(
+                        vv,
+                        rsrc(a["part_o"]),
+                        (th * KVL + lat) // 2,
+                        cache_modifier=c["cm"],
+                    )
+
+
+@traced
+def ws_run(c):
+    """Warp-specialized blocks (``WSPEC``): the QK waves', the PV waves'."""
+    wv = uniform(c["wave"])
+    if wv < QKW:
+        ws_qk(c)
+    if wv >= QKW:
+        ws_pv(c)
+
+
+def check(s: int, q: int, rt: int = 0):
+    assert q in (4, 8) and s % q == 0
+    # slot 1 holds the bf16 Q rows and their fp8 hi | lo (``q_split``)
+    assert (rt or RTILES[q]) * TILE * ENTRY <= SLOT
+    assert NH % geometry(q, rt)[0] == 0
+    # warp-specialized: 2 row tiles
+    assert not wspec(rt or RTILES[q]) or (rt or RTILES[q]) == 2
+    assert splits(q, rt) % (s // q) == 0, (splits(q, rt), s // q)
+
+
+def smem(qlen: int, rt: int = 0, ws: int = -1):
+    """The LDS of a CTA (``cta``'s ks / xm / xp / xi; xp P's hi | lo, then
+    the tail Q's tail hi | lo, ``qt``)."""
+    rt = rt or RTILES[qlen]
+    xpn = rt * WAVES * 64 * 2
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        ks: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 2 * SLOT, 16]
+        xm: fx.Array[fx.Float32, rt * WAVES * TILE, 16]
+        xp: fx.Array[fx.Int32, xpn + rt * TILE * 2 * CHUNK // 4, 16]
+        xi: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 2 * WAVES * TILE, 16]
+
+    return Smem
+
+
+@traced
+def cta(c):
+    """CTA ``c["bid"]``'s (head group, split): its partial stored (cache
+    modifier ``c["cm"]``), then ``c["done"](flag)`` when given (``ctas``).
+    ``c["args"]``: qb, kv, pages, indptr, part_o, part_lse, scale, vscale."""
+    s, q, a = c["S"], c["Q"], c["args"]
+    rt = c.get("rt") or RTILES[q]
+    ws = wspec(rt, c.get("ws", -1))
+    ht, hg, spx = geometry(q, rt)
+    nreq = s // q
+    per_req = splits(q, rt) // nreq
+    bid, tid = c["bid"], c["tid"]
+    lane = tid % 64
+    wave = tid // 64
+    g = lane // TILE
+    row = lane % TILE
+    x = bid % XCDS
+    u = bid // XCDS
+    if u < spx * hg:
+        gs = x * spx + u // hg  # global split
+        req = gs % nreq
+        split = gs // nreq
+        hd = [(u % hg) * ht + r * (TILE // q) + row // q for r in range(rt)]
+        pos = row % q
+        t = req * q + pos
+        p0 = uniform(ld_i32(a["indptr"], req))
+        L = uniform(ld_i32(a["indptr"], req + 1)) - p0
+        # an empty request's p0 may be pages' end: its (unused) block-0 loads
+        # read pages[0] instead
+        p0 = (L > 0).select(p0, fx.Int32(0))
+        ct = ((L + per_req - 1) // per_req + TILE - 1) // TILE * TILE
+        c0 = split * ct
+        c1 = fx.min(L, c0 + ct)
+        ntile = (fx.max(c1 - c0, 0) + TILE - 1) // TILE
+        dt, dcc = dma_lane(lane)
+        # a new dict (the branch would carry a mutated ``c`` out as values)
+        d = dict(
+            c,
+            rt=rt,
+            # the line layout (a DMA 8 tokens' whole lines) at 1 row tile;
+            # at 2 its extra VGPRs spill in the fused K2 builds (a reload a
+            # block, whose vmcnt(0) waits out every DMA): 64 B chunks
+            lines=rt == 1,
+            lane=lane,
+            wave=wave,
+            dt=dt,
+            dcc=dcc,
+            dcol=16 * ((lane % 8) ^ sig(lane // 8, wave % 2)) if rt == 1 else 0,
+            ks_b=fx.Int32(fx.ptrtoint(c["ks"])),
+            xi_b=fx.Int32(fx.ptrtoint(c["xi"])),
+            qt=c["xp"] + rt * WAVES * 64 * 2,
+            p0=p0,
+            c0=c0,
+            last=fx.max(c1 - 1, 0),
+        )
+        # block 0's DMA before the Q loads (one in-order vmcnt: the indices'
+        # wait would hold for them too)
+        k_dma(d, 0, dma_offs(d, idx_load(d, 0)))
+        idx_dma(d, 1)
+        if const_expr(ws):
+            idx_dma(d, 2)
+        # the CTA's Q rows (16 r + row: [r][row][ENTRY] bf16) -> slot 1
+        # once, a DMA a 1 KB (a wave every WAVES-th; the last repeated):
+        # the waves' own loads of it would outweigh a K block 8 x
+        rowb = 2 * ENTRY
+        nq = rt * TILE * rowb // 1024
+        for i in range_constexpr((nq + WAVES - 1) // WAVES):
+            k = fx.min(wave + WAVES * i, nq - 1) * 64 + lane
+            lr = k // (rowb // 16)
+            qh = (u % hg) * ht + (lr // TILE) * (TILE // q) + (lr % TILE) // q
+            qt = req * q + (lr % TILE) % q
+            lds_dma(
+                a["qb"] + fx.Int64((qt * NH + qh) * rowb + k % (rowb // 16) * 16),
+                d["ks_b"] + (SLOT * 4 + (k - lane) * 16),
+            )
+        wait_dma()
+        # Q -> fp8 hi / lo (slot 1 after the bf16 rows), then Q^T's B operands
+        rows = rt * TILE
+        at = SLOT + rows * ENTRY // 2
+        q_split(d, rows, at)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        qv = [q_parts(d, r, at, rows) for r in range(rt)]
+        scale = fx.Int32(a["scale"]).bitcast(fx.Float32) * fx.Float32(LOG2E)
+        qsc = [scale * fx.ptr_load(c["xm"] + r * TILE + row) for r in range(rt)]
+        # every wave's reads before block 1's DMA into slot 1
+        gpu.barrier()
+        d.update(
+            qpos=(
+                [lines_at(row, wave % 2, 2 * g + k) // 4 for k in range(2)]
+                if rt == 1
+                else [None, None]
+            )
+            + [4 * kpos(row, g)],
+            vtr=[vtr_lane(lane, wave, i, rt == 1) for i in range(4)],
+            vb=d["ks_b"] + 2 * (wave - QKW) * WAVES * TILEW * 4,
+            q=qv,
+            qscale=qsc,
+            t=t,
+            h=hd,
+            split=req * per_req + split,
+            bound=L - q + pos,
+            nblk=(ntile + WAVES - 1) // WAVES,
+            nfull=fx.max(fx.min(c1, L - q + 1) - c0, 0) // BLK,
+            vscale=fx.Int32(a["vscale"]).bitcast(fx.Float32),
+        )
+        stamp(d, 0)
+        if const_expr(ws):
+            ws_run(d)
+        else:
+            run(d)
+        if const_expr("done" in d):
+            d["done"]((req * per_req + split) * hg + u % hg)
+
+
+_BUILDS: dict = {}
+
+
+def build(key: MlaAttnBuild):
+    if key in _BUILDS:
+        return _BUILDS[key]
+    s, q = key.tokens, key.qlen
+    check(s, q, key.rt)
+    Smem = smem(q, key.rt, key.ws)
+
+    keyed = key_tuple(key, _SOURCES)
+    name = f"k3_mono_mla_attn_s{s}_q{q}_r{key.rt or RTILES[q]}"
+    name += "_w" if key.wide else ""
+    name += "_ws" if wspec(key.rt or RTILES[q], key.ws) else ""
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def mla_attn(
+        qb: Int64,
+        kv: Int64,
+        pages: Int64,
+        indptr: Int64,
+        part_o: Int64,
+        part_lse: Int64,
+        scale: Int32,
+        vscale: Int32,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Smem).peek()
+        cta(
+            {
+                "S": s,
+                "Q": q,
+                "stamps": key.stamps,
+                "dbg": key.dbg,
+                "rt": key.rt,
+                "wide": key.wide,
+                "ws": key.ws,
+                "bid": bid,
+                "tid": tid,
+                "cm": 0,
+                "ks": lds.ks.ptr,
+                "xm": lds.xm.ptr,
+                "xp": lds.xp.ptr,
+                "xi": lds.xi.ptr,
+                "args": {
+                    "qb": qb,
+                    "kv": kv,
+                    "pages": pages,
+                    "indptr": indptr,
+                    "part_o": part_o,
+                    "part_lse": part_lse,
+                    "scale": scale,
+                    "vscale": vscale,
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        qb: Int64,
+        kv: Int64,
+        pages: Int64,
+        indptr: Int64,
+        part_o: Int64,
+        part_lse: Int64,
+        scale: Int32,
+        vscale: Int32,
+        stream: fx.Stream = _STREAM,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        mla_attn(qb, kv, pages, indptr, part_o, part_lse, scale, vscale).launch(
+            grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream
+        )
+
+    _BUILDS[key] = launch
+    return launch
+
+
+def partial_shapes(key: MlaAttnBuild):
+    n = splits(key.qlen, key.rt)
+    return (n, key.tokens, NH, KVL), (n, key.tokens, NH)
+
+
+def f32_bits(x: float) -> int:
+    return int(torch.tensor(float(x), dtype=torch.float32).view(torch.int32))
+
+
+def mla_attn(
+    key: MlaAttnBuild, *, q, kv, pages, indptr, part_o, part_lse, scale, kv_scale=1.0
+):
+    """Host launcher. ``q`` [S, 12, 576] bf16; ``kv`` [tokens, 576] fp8 rows
+    (dense); ``pages`` int32 flat token indices, ``indptr`` [requests + 1]
+    int32 (a request's KV ``pages[indptr[r]:indptr[r + 1]]``); ``part_o`` /
+    ``part_lse`` of ``partial_shapes(key)``, bf16 / f32. ``scale`` the softmax
+    scale, ``kv_scale`` the cache's dequant (folded into QK and o)."""
+    so, sl = partial_shapes(key)
+    assert part_o.shape == so and part_o.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert part_lse.shape == sl and part_lse.dtype == torch.float32
+    assert q.shape == (key.tokens, NH, ENTRY), q.shape
+    a = host_args(
+        q=q, kv=kv, pages=pages, indptr=indptr, scale=scale, kv_scale=kv_scale
+    )
+    build(replace(key, wide=key.wide or wide_kv(kv)))(
+        *a[:4],
+        part_o.data_ptr(),
+        part_lse.data_ptr(),
+        *a[4:],
+        stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+    )
+
+
+def wide_kv(kv) -> bool:
+    """The build's ``wide`` for KV pool ``kv``: a DMA's 32-bit offset off the
+    pool's base (a token row's end at most) won't reach past 4 GiB."""
+    return kv.numel() > 2**32
+
+
+def host_args(*, q, kv, pages, indptr, scale, kv_scale=1.0):
+    """(qb, kv, pages, indptr, scale, vscale) of the kernel (``mla_attn``'s
+    inputs but the partials; K2's fused M1c's)."""
+    assert (
+        q.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and q.is_contiguous() and q.shape[1:] == (NH, ENTRY)
+    )
+    assert kv.element_size() == 1 and kv.stride(-1) == 1 and kv.size(-1) == ENTRY
+    assert kv.stride(0) == ENTRY
+    assert pages.dtype == torch.int32 and indptr.dtype == torch.int32
+    return [
+        q.data_ptr(),
+        kv.data_ptr(),
+        pages.data_ptr(),
+        indptr.data_ptr(),
+        f32_bits(scale * kv_scale),
+        f32_bits(kv_scale),
+    ]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""M1c ``mla_attn``'s launch geometry, without the kernel's FlyDSL imports: the
+runtime's config checks (``runtime.m1c_serves``) size M1c's KV splits on any
+platform."""
+
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import BLOCKS
+
+NH = 12  # local heads at TP8 (``mla.NH``)
+XCDS = 8
+TILE = 16  # tokens a wave's tile
+RTILES = {4: 1, 8: 2}  # row tiles a CTA by qlen (3 head groups either way)
+
+
+def splits(qlen: int, rt: int = 0) -> int:
+    """KV splits of the launch (every request's together): the head groups'
+    CTAs an XCD hold a whole number of splits."""
+    return XCDS * geometry(qlen, rt)[2]
+
+
+def geometry(qlen: int, rt: int = 0):
+    """(heads a CTA, head groups, splits an XCD); a CTA ``rt`` row tiles of 16
+    (``RTILES`` by default)."""
+    ht = TILE * (rt or RTILES[qlen]) // qlen
+    hg = NH // ht
+    return ht, hg, BLOCKS // XCDS // hg
+
+
+def ctas(qlen: int, rt: int = 0) -> int:
+    """The working CTAs (0 .. ctas): a done flag each when fused (``cta``'s
+    ``done``), at (split, head group) ``split * hg + group``."""
+    _, hg, spx = geometry(qlen, rt)
+    return XCDS * spx * hg

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""M1b ``mla_post``: one Kimi-K3 MLA layer from AITER's decode output to
+o_proj's input, at TP8 + DCP8 (the DCP group the TP group) or TP8 + DCP1.
+
+AITER leaves every rank the partial attention of its KV shard for all the
+gathered heads (``o`` [S, ranks x 12, 512] bf16 and ``lse`` [S, ranks x 12]
+f32, strided views). As ``dcp_a2a_lse_reduce`` -> ``_v_up_proj`` -> the gate:
+
+    push (a wave a (token, head), over every CTA)
+                        o / lse of rank p's heads -> rank p's CMB: the o row
+                        untagged, then the LSE pair as its flag (an LSE of
+                        -inf for a row with no local KV or past the batch, as
+                        ``_dcp_a2a_pack_send_kernel`` masks it)
+    combine (a CTA a (head, 4 tokens))
+                        the ranks' partials in rank order, LSE-weighted in
+                        fp32 -> bf16 latents in LDS
+    W_UV (a wave 16 of the head's 128 rows)
+                        the latents -> MXFP4 (aiter's even scale), four FP4
+                        MFMAs against W_V -> bf16, times the gate -> ``core``
+
+At DCP1 (``ranks`` 1) ``o`` [S, 12, 512] is already the attention's output, as
+vLLM hands it to ``_v_up_proj``: no push, no LSE; the combine stage loads it.
+With ``splits`` (M1c ``mla_attn``'s partials: ``o`` / ``lse`` split 0 of dense
+[splits, S, 12, 512] bf16 / [splits, S, 12] f32) the combine stage merges a
+token's request's splits, LSE-weighted.
+
+K2 (``layer``, ``K2Build.m1b_qlen``) runs these stages in its own launch.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+import torch
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import Int32, Int64, T
+
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention.kda import (
+    LOG2E,
+    MAX_S,
+    bf16r,
+    step_tag,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention.mla import (
+    GROWS,
+    KVL,
+    NH,
+    even_code,
+    pk_fp4_bf16,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.debug import (
+    region_ids,
+    stamp,
+    stamp_begin,
+    stamp_flush,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.mx import (
+    FP4,
+    mfma_scaled,
+    pow2,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_SYS,
+    bf16_pair,
+    bf_hi,
+    bf_lo,
+    butterfly,
+    hw_exp2,
+    hw_rcp,
+    ld_i32,
+    load_ptr64,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (
+    BLOCKS,
+    THREADS,
+    WAVES,
+    KernelAbi,
+    first_task,
+    key_tuple,
+    source_digest,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ranks import peer_bases
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import Mailbox, preg
+
+VD = 128  # v_head_dim
+CW = KVL // 2 + 2  # CMB pairs a (source, token, head): 256 o words, the LSE, pad
+OU = KVL // 4  # the LSE's pair in a CMB row
+TT = 4  # tokens a combine task
+KS = KVL // 128  # W_UV's 128-k MFMA steps
+LROW = KVL // 2 + 4  # an LDS latent row (words, padded)
+WMAX = 128  # M1c splits a request at most (an LDS weight row)
+CB = 8  # combine_splits' o loads in flight a thread (1 with M1c in the launch)
+# timeline points: start, push, combine, W_UV
+TL_POINTS = 4
+
+assert VD == WAVES * 16 and THREADS == TT * (KVL // 4) and KVL // 2 == 64 * 4
+
+_STREAM = fx.Stream(None)
+REGIONS = ("cmb",)
+_SOURCES = source_digest(".")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MlaPostBuild:
+    tokens: int  # S
+    qlen: int  # tokens a request (1 + speculative)
+    ranks: int = 8  # 1: DCP1, no peer memory
+    peer_off: int = 0  # CMB's byte offset in a rank's peer buffer
+    timeline: bool = False
+    splits: int = 0  # DCP1: M1c's KV splits (0: ``o`` the attention's output)
+    ctok: int = 0  # tokens a combine task (0: ``ctok``'s)
+
+
+ABI = KernelAbi(
+    (
+        "o",
+        "o_sb",
+        "o_sh",
+        "lse",
+        "lse_sb",
+        "lse_sh",
+        "seq_lens",
+        "qsl",
+        "w_v",
+        "wv_sh",
+        "wv_sn",
+        "w_vs",
+        "vs_sh",
+        "vs_sn",
+        "vs_sk",
+        "gate",
+        "core",
+        "peers",
+        "rank",
+        "layer",
+        "epoch",
+        "health",
+        "alarm",
+        "tl",
+    )
+)
+
+
+def peer_pairs(s: int, ranks: int) -> int:
+    return ranks * s * NH * CW
+
+
+def peer_bytes(s: int, ranks: int) -> int:
+    return peer_pairs(s, ranks) * 8
+
+
+def cmb_pair(c, src, t, h):
+    return ((src * c["S"] + t) * NH + h) * CW
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- push
+@traced
+def stage_push(c):
+    """Rank p's heads of this rank's partials -> rank p's CMB: a wave a (token,
+    head), the waves over every CTA first. The o row goes untagged (a lane 16 B
+    a destination, half the bytes of tagged pairs: the push is xGMI-bound), then
+    once the wave's stores drained, the LSE pair, its tag the row's flag."""
+    s, q, bid, a = c["S"], c["Q"], c["bid"], c["args"]
+    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    nr = s * NH
+    nw = BLOCKS * WAVES
+    for i in range_constexpr((nr + nw - 1) // nw):
+        g = (wave + WAVES * i) * BLOCKS + bid
+        if g < nr:
+            h = g % NH
+            t = g // NH
+            # the request's local KV empty, or a row past the batch: LSE -inf
+            rows = ld_i32(a["qsl"], s // q)
+            empty = (ld_i32(a["seq_lens"], t // q) == 0) | (t >= rows)
+            at = cmb_pair(c, c["rank"], t, h)
+            lses = []
+            for p in range_constexpr(c["R"]):
+                gh = p * NH + h
+                w = bo.buffer_load(
+                    rsrc(a["o"]),
+                    (t * a["o_sb"] + gh * a["o_sh"]) // 2 + 4 * lane,
+                    vec_width=4,
+                    dtype=T.i32,
+                )
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    w, rsrc(c["cmb"][p].value), at * 2 + 4 * lane, cache_modifier=CM_SYS
+                )
+                lse = fx.Int32(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        rsrc(a["lse"]),
+                        t * a["lse_sb"] + gh * a["lse_sh"],
+                        vec_width=1,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                    )
+                )
+                lses.append(empty.select(fx.Int32(-8388608), lse))  # -inf
+            # the wave's row stores acknowledged before its flags (a wave's
+            # own stores: no barrier)
+            rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+            for p in range_constexpr(c["R"]):
+                if lane == p:
+                    c["put_words"](c["cmb"][p], at + 2 * OU, [lses[p], fx.Int32(0)])
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- combine
+def sane(lse):
+    """NaN / +inf -> -inf (``_dcp_a2a_unpack_combine_kernel``)."""
+    bad = (lse != lse) | (lse == fx.Float32(float("inf")))
+    return bad.select(fx.Float32(float("-inf")), lse)
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_combine(c, h, t0):
+    """Tokens t0 .. t0 + 4 of head h: thread (token tid / 128, latents
+    4 (tid % 128) ..) combines the ranks' partials into the LDS row."""
+    s, R, tid = c["S"], c["R"], c["tid"]
+    tt = tid // (KVL // 4)
+    cc = tid % (KVL // 4)
+    t = fx.min(t0 + tt, s - 1)
+    if const_expr(R == 1 and c["splits"] > 0):
+        combine_splits(c, t0, h)
+    if const_expr(R == 1 and c["splits"] == 0):
+        a = c["args"]
+        o = fx.Vector(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                rsrc(a["o"]),
+                (t * a["o_sb"] + h * a["o_sh"]) // 2 + 2 * cc,
+                vec_width=2,
+                dtype=T.i32,
+            )
+        )
+        live = t0 + tt < s
+        base = c["lat"] + tt * LROW + 2 * cc
+        fx.ptr_store(live.select(o[0], fx.Int32(0)), base)
+        fx.ptr_store(live.select(o[1], fx.Int32(0)), base + 1)
+    if const_expr(R > 1):
+        combine_ranks(c, h, t0, tt, cc, t)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def combine_splits(c, t0, h):
+    """``stage_combine`` at DCP1 over M1c's partials: token t's request's splits
+    (``splits / requests`` of them, request-major), LSE-weighted. Wave tt < tc
+    (the task's tokens) turns token t0 + tt's LSEs into weights (LDS ``cw``);
+    then a token's WAVES / tc waves (parts) sum the splits part, part + parts,
+    .. a thread 8 latents of a token (16 B loads, CB in flight), the parts'
+    sums halved through ``cw`` (the upper half's handed over) to part 0."""
+    s, q, n, a, tid, tc = c["S"], c["Q"], c["splits"], c["args"], c["tid"], c["TC"]
+    per = n // (s // q)
+    sp0 = t0 // q * per
+    wv, lane = tid // 64, tid % 64
+    if const_expr("ardy" in c):
+        # M1c in this launch (its VGPRs at the limit): the wave index scalar
+        wv = uniform(wv)
+        # its CTAs' flags (split, head group of M1c's ``ht`` heads), a thread each
+        ht = c["m1c_ht"]
+        if tid < per:
+            c["poll"]([(c["ardy"], (sp0 + tid) * (NH // ht) + h // ht, 1)])
+        gpu.barrier()
+    if wv < tc:
+        t = fx.min(t0 + wv, s - 1)
+        lse = []
+        for k in range_constexpr((per + 63) // 64):
+            i = lane + 64 * k
+            v = fx.Int32(
+                bo.buffer_load(
+                    rsrc(a["lse"]),
+                    ((sp0 + fx.min(i, per - 1)) * s + t) * NH + h,
+                    vec_width=1,
+                    dtype=T.i32,
+                )
+            ).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+            lse.append((i < per).select(sane(v), fx.Float32(float("-inf"))))
+        m = lse[0]
+        for k in range_constexpr(1, len(lse)):
+            m = fx.max(m, lse[k])
+        m = butterfly(m, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1), fx.max)
+        m = (m == fx.Float32(float("-inf"))).select(fx.Float32(0.0), m)
+        e = [hw_exp2((x - m) * fx.Float32(LOG2E)) for x in lse]
+        tot = e[0]
+        for k in range_constexpr(1, len(e)):
+            tot = tot + e[k]
+        tot = butterfly(tot, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+        # a padded request (no KV): every split empty, its rows 0
+        inv = (tot == fx.Float32(0.0)).select(fx.Float32(0.0), hw_rcp(tot))
+        for k in range_constexpr(len(e)):
+            fx.ptr_store(e[k] * inv, c["cw"] + wv * WMAX + lane + 64 * k)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    parts = WAVES // tc
+    part, tt = wv // tc, wv % tc
+    t = fx.min(t0 + tt, s - 1)
+    nj = per // parts  # splits a part
+    src = (((sp0 + part) * s + t) * NH + h) * (KVL // 2) + 4 * lane
+    wrow = c["cw"] + tt * WMAX + part
+    stride = parts * s * NH * KVL * 2  # bytes between a part's splits
+    acc = [fx.Float32(0.0)] * 8
+
+    def batch(acc, j0, nb):
+        os_ = [
+            fx.Vector(
+                bo.buffer_load(
+                    rsrc(a["o"]),
+                    src,
+                    vec_width=4,
+                    dtype=T.i32,
+                    soffset_bytes=(j0 + j) * stride,
+                )
+            )
+            for j in range(nb)
+        ]
+        # an empty split: weight 0, its o 0
+        wts = [fx.ptr_load(wrow + (j0 + j) * parts) for j in range(nb)]
+        acc = list(acc)
+        for j in range_constexpr(nb):
+            o, wt = os_[j], wts[j]
+            for k in range_constexpr(4):
+                acc[2 * k] = acc[2 * k] + bf_lo(o[k]) * wt
+                acc[2 * k + 1] = acc[2 * k + 1] + bf_hi(o[k]) * wt
+        return acc
+
+    if const_expr("ardy" in c):
+        # with M1c: unrolled, a load a batch (a loop, or wider batches, spill
+        # M1c's Q fragment in its loop)
+        for j0 in range_constexpr(nj):
+            acc = batch(acc, j0, 1)
+    else:
+        # CB loads in flight a batch (a loop over the batches: the scheduler
+        # hoists no further), the rest unrolled
+        jb = fx.Int32(0)
+        while jb < nj // CB * CB:
+            acc = batch(acc, jb, CB)
+            jb = jb + CB
+        if const_expr(nj % CB):
+            acc = batch(acc, nj // CB * CB, nj % CB)
+    # parts p >= hf hand their sums to p - hf, halving
+    for hf in [parts >> k for k in range(1, parts.bit_length())]:
+        red = c["cw"] + TT * WMAX + (tt * 64 + lane) * 8
+        if (part >= hf) & (part < 2 * hf):
+            at = red + (part - hf) * (tc * 64 * 8)
+            for k in range_constexpr(2):
+                fx.ptr_store(
+                    fx.Vector.from_elements(acc[4 * k : 4 * k + 4], fx.Float32),
+                    at + 4 * k,
+                )
+        gpu.barrier()
+        if const_expr(hf > 1):
+            at = red + fx.min(part, hf - 1) * (tc * 64 * 8)
+            acc = [
+                (part < hf).select(acc[i] + fx.ptr_load(at + i), acc[i])
+                for i in range(8)
+            ]
+            gpu.barrier()  # read before the next half's stores
+        else:
+            acc = [acc[i] + fx.ptr_load(red + i) for i in range(8)]
+    if part == 0:
+        live = t0 + tt < s
+        for k in range_constexpr(4):
+            fx.ptr_store(
+                live.select(
+                    bf16_pair(acc[2 * k], acc[2 * k + 1]).bitcast(fx.Int32),
+                    fx.Int32(0),
+                ),
+                c["lat"] + tt * LROW + 4 * lane + k,
+            )
+
+
+@traced
+def combine_ranks(c, h, t0, tt, cc, t):
+    """``stage_combine`` at DCP8: the ranks' CMB partials, LSE-weighted."""
+    s, R = c["S"], c["R"]
+    specs = [(c["cmb_own"], cmb_pair(c, src, t, h) + 2 * OU, 1) for src in range(R)]
+    got = c["poll"](specs)
+    lse = [sane(got[r][0].bitcast(fx.Float32)) for r in range(R)]
+    # each source's row, untagged: its LSE flag above announced it
+    rows = [
+        fx.Vector(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                rsrc(c["cmb_own"].value),
+                cmb_pair(c, src, t, h) * 2 + 2 * cc,
+                vec_width=2,
+                dtype=T.i32,
+                cache_modifier=CM_SYS,
+            )
+        )
+        for src in range(R)
+    ]
+    m = lse[0]
+    for r in range_constexpr(1, R):
+        m = fx.max(m, lse[r])
+    m = (m == fx.Float32(float("-inf"))).select(fx.Float32(0.0), m)
+    e = [hw_exp2((lse[r] - m) * fx.Float32(LOG2E)) for r in range(R)]
+    tot = e[0]
+    for r in range_constexpr(1, R):
+        tot = tot + e[r]
+    inv = hw_rcp(tot)

+def attend(wrapper, q8, kv_cache, md):
+    """The partial (this rank's KV) attention: ``o`` [S, heads * dcp, 512] and
+    its LSE [S, heads * dcp] (None at DCP1), both possibly strided views.
+
+    ``q8`` may carry more heads than the layer: AITER's cprr pad (e.g. 96 ->
+    128, M1a writes it). forward_mqa gets the real heads, a view whose row
+    stride spans the pad, and AITER's ``get_mla_padded_q`` widens it back to
+    ``q8`` instead of copying."""
+    from vllm.platforms import current_platform

+    attn = wrapper.mla_attn
+    kv = kv_cache.view(current_platform.fp8_dtype())

+def m1c_inputs(wrapper, q, kv_cache, md):
+    """K2's ``m1c_in`` for M1a's bf16 query ``q`` [S, 12, 576] and its new
+    partials, o [splits, S, 12, 512] bf16 and LSE [splits, S, 12] f32 (M1b
+    merges the splits)."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention import mla_attn
+    from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+    attn = wrapper.mla_attn
+    decode = md.decode
+    kv = kv_cache.view(current_platform.fp8_dtype())
+    key = mla_attn.MlaAttnBuild(tokens=q.size(0), qlen=int(decode.max_qo_len))
+    so, sl = mla_attn.partial_shapes(key)
+    m1c_in = dict(
+        q=q,
+        kv=kv.view(-1, kv.size(-1)),  # the flat token rows
+        pages=decode.paged_kv_indices,
+        indptr=decode.paged_kv_indptr,
+        scale=attn.impl.scale,
+        kv_scale=float(attn._k_scale_float),

+    po = q.new_empty(so)
+    return m1c_in, po, torch.empty(sl, dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)

+def post(wrapper, o, lse, md, gate):
+    """o_proj's input [S, heads * 128] bf16."""
+    attn = wrapper.mla_attn
+    latent = o
+    if attn.impl.dcp_world_size > 1:
+        latent = attn.dcp_manager.combine(
+            o,
+            lse,
+            seq_lens=md.decode.seq_lens,
+            query_start_loc=md.query_start_loc[: md.num_decodes + 1],
+        )
+    core = gate.new_empty(gate.shape)
+    attn._v_up_proj(latent, out=core)
+    return core * gate

[Perf][MiniMax-M3] (NVIDIA-only) Fused norm+quant MXFP8 (#64852)

Signed-off-by: Thien Tran <gau.nernst@yahoo.com.sg>
Co-authored-by: Kimi Code <noreply@moonshot.cn>
Co-authored-by: vllm-agent <claw@inferact.ai>

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The MiniMax-M3 Triton input norm against the FlashInfer norm (plus the
+reference MXFP8 quantize for MXFP8 output): residual and UE8M0 scales bitwise,
+E4M3 codes within one quantization step, BF16 output within one BF16 ulp."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="CUDA only")
+
+HIDDEN = 6144
+
+
+def _rows(n: int, k: int, gen: torch.Generator) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Per-32-block magnitudes over 2^-20..2^20, plus special rows."""
+    x = torch.randn(n, k, generator=gen, device="cuda")
+    e = torch.randint(-20, 21, (n, k // 32, 1), generator=gen, device="cuda")
+    x = (x.view(n, -1, 32) * torch.pow(2.0, e.float())).view(n, k)
+    if n >= 4:
+        x[0] = 0.0
+        x[1] = 1e-40
+        x[2] = float("inf")
+        x[3] = 448.0
+    return x.to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _code_steps(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor, dtype: torch.dtype) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Per-element code distance in value order; NaN codes must match exactly.
+
+    ``dtype`` is the value dtype: float8_e4m3fn (E4M3 codes) or bfloat16."""
+    n = 256 if dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn else 65536
+    int_dtype = torch.uint8 if dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn else torch.uint16
+    codes = torch.arange(n, dtype=torch.int32, device=a.device).to(int_dtype)
+    vals = codes.view(dtype).float()
+    rank = torch.empty(n, dtype=torch.int32, device=a.device)
+    rank[vals.argsort()] = torch.arange(n, dtype=torch.int32, device=a.device)
+    a_i = a.contiguous().view(int_dtype).long()
+    b_i = b.contiguous().view(int_dtype).long()
+    a_nan, b_nan = vals.isnan()[a_i], vals.isnan()[b_i]
+    assert torch.equal(a_nan, b_nan), "NaN pattern mismatch"
+    return torch.where(a_nan, 0, (rank[a_i] - rank[b_i]).abs())
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mxfp8", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fused_add", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("num_tokens", "strided"), [(1, False), (129, True), (1024, False)]
+)
+def test_input_norm_matches_reference(num_tokens, strided, fused_add, mxfp8):
+    from flashinfer.norm import gemma_fused_add_rmsnorm, gemma_rmsnorm
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+        mxfp8_e4m3_quantize,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia.ops.norm_mxfp8 import gemma_rmsnorm_mxfp8
+
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(num_tokens)
+    x = _rows(num_tokens, HIDDEN, gen)
+    residual = _rows(num_tokens, HIDDEN, gen)
+    weight = (torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=gen, device="cuda") * 0.2).to(x.dtype)
+    eps = 1e-6
+
+    x_ref, res_ref = x.clone(), residual.clone()
+    if fused_add:
+        gemma_fused_add_rmsnorm(x_ref, res_ref, weight, eps)
+        y_ref = x_ref
+    else:
+        y_ref = gemma_rmsnorm(x_ref, weight, eps)
+
+    if strided:
+        # Row-contiguous views with row stride 2*H.
+        x_buf = torch.empty(num_tokens, 2 * HIDDEN, dtype=x.dtype, device="cuda")
+        res_buf = torch.empty_like(x_buf)
+        x_buf[:, :HIDDEN], res_buf[:, :HIDDEN] = x, residual
+        x_new, res_new = x_buf[:, :HIDDEN], res_buf[:, :HIDDEN]
+    else:
+        x_new, res_new = x.clone(), residual.clone()
+    out, s = gemma_rmsnorm_mxfp8(
+        x_new, weight, eps, residual=res_new if fused_add else None, mxfp8=mxfp8
+    )
+
+    if fused_add:
+        assert torch.equal(res_new.contiguous(), res_ref)
+    assert torch.equal(x_new.contiguous(), x)
+    if mxfp8:
+        q_ref, s_ref = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(y_ref, is_sf_swizzled_layout=True)
+        assert torch.equal(s, s_ref)
+        steps = _code_steps(out, q_ref, torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    else:
+        assert s is None
+        steps = _code_steps(out, y_ref, torch.bfloat16)
+    assert steps.max().item() <= 1
+
+
+def test_norm_module_accepts_3d_per_head():
+    """The dspark drafter norms per-head context K with (tokens, heads,
+    head_dim); the module routes non-2-D inputs to the FlashInfer norm."""
+    from flashinfer.norm import gemma_rmsnorm

+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia.model import MiniMAXGemmaRMSNorm

+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)

+    y_ref = gemma_rmsnorm(x.clone(), norm.weight, norm.variance_epsilon)
+    out = norm(x)
+    assert out.shape == x.shape
+    assert torch.equal(out, y_ref)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Gemma RMSNorm (optionally fused with the residual add) in one Triton pass.
+
+With an ``sf`` scale buffer the output is E4M3 data plus UE8M0 scales in the
+128x4 swizzled layout, replacing the BF16 norm followed by a separate MXFP8
+quantize (which re-reads the full normed activation). Without it, the output
+is the plain BF16 norm. The residual is bitwise the BF16 norm's; the
+quantized data and scales match the reference quantize within one E4M3 step
+(the rstd reduction order differs).
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import round_up
+
+MXFP8_BLOCK = 32
+SF_ROW_TILE = 128
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["M"])
+def _gemma_rmsnorm_mxfp8_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    res_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    sf_ptr,
+    M,
+    x_stride0,
+    res_stride0,
+    eps,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    launch_pdl: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    SF_ROW_TILE: tl.constexpr = 128
+    G: tl.constexpr = H // 32
+    GP: tl.constexpr = triton.next_power_of_2(H) // 32
+    PADDED_COLS: tl.constexpr = (G + 3) // 4 * 4
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    g = tl.arange(0, GP)
+    if launch_pdl:
+        # All CTAs wait for the predecessor before any global access (the
+        # padding-row stores included), then release dependents before the
+        # loads: the consumer (the weight-loading GEMM) overlaps.
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_launch_dependents()
+    if sf_ptr is not None:
+        # Swizzled 128x4 scale layout [m_tile, k_tile, 32, 4, 4].
+        sf_off = (
+            (g % 4)
+            + (g // 4) * 512
+            + (row % 32) * 16
+            + ((row % SF_ROW_TILE) // 32) * 4
+            + (row // SF_ROW_TILE) * (SF_ROW_TILE * PADDED_COLS)
+        )
+        if row >= M:
+            # Zero the padding rows of the swizzled scale tensor.
+            tl.store(sf_ptr + sf_off, tl.zeros((GP,), tl.uint8), mask=g < G)
+            return
+
+    cols = g[:, None] * 32 + tl.arange(0, 32)[None, :]
+    mask = cols < H
+    x = tl.load(x_ptr + row * x_stride0 + cols, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    w = tl.load(w_ptr + cols, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    if res_ptr is not None:
+        r = tl.load(res_ptr + row * res_stride0 + cols, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    h = x.to(tl.float32)
+    if res_ptr is not None:
+        h += r.to(tl.float32)
+        tl.store(res_ptr + row * res_stride0 + cols, h, mask=mask)
+    var = tl.sum(h * h) / H
+    rstd = tl.rsqrt(var + eps)
+    y = (h * rstd * (1.0 + w.to(tl.float32))).to(tl.bfloat16)
+
+    if sf_ptr is not None:
+        amax = tl.max(tl.abs(y.to(tl.float32)), axis=1)
+        scale = amax * (1.0 / 448.0)
+        # UE8M0 scale: ceil to a power of two (exponent bump when the
+        # mantissa is nonzero, except tiny subnormals), clamped to [0, 254].
+        bits = scale.to(tl.uint32, bitcast=True)
+        exp = (bits >> 23) & 255
+        mant = bits & 0x7FFFFF
+        bump = (mant != 0) & ~((exp == 0) & (mant <= 0x400000))
+        e = tl.minimum(exp + bump.to(tl.uint32), 254)
+        e = tl.where(scale <= 0.0, 0, e)
+        # Inverse scale 2^(127 - e) (0 for e == 0), always a power of two.
+        inv_bits = tl.where(e == 0, 0, (254 - e) << 23)
+        inv = inv_bits.to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+        # Bitwise the reference conversion (saturating; NaN -> +448);
+        # checked exhaustively over all BF16 values and power-of-two scales.
+        q = tl.clamp(y.to(tl.float32) * inv[:, None], -448.0, 448.0)
+        tl.store(
+            out_ptr + row * H + cols,
+            q.to(tl.float8e4nv).to(tl.uint8, bitcast=True),
+            mask=mask,
+        )
+        tl.store(sf_ptr + sf_off, e.to(tl.uint8), mask=g < G)
+    else:
+        tl.store(out_ptr + row * H + cols, y, mask=mask)
+
+
+def gemma_rmsnorm_mxfp8(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    mxfp8: bool = True,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+    """GemmaRMSNorm of ``x`` (plus ``residual`` in place when given).
+
+    Args:
+        x: (num_tokens, hidden) BF16 activation, contiguous along the row
+            (any row stride). Read only.
+        weight: (hidden,) norm weight; the norm scales by (1 + weight).
+        eps: RMS norm epsilon.
+        residual: same shape/dtype/stride(1) as x; updated in place to
+            x + residual. None for a plain norm.
+        mxfp8: return MXFP8 (E4M3 data + UE8M0 scales) or the plain BF16
+            normed activation.
+
+    Returns:
+        ``(data, scale)``: with ``mxfp8=True``, E4M3 data (num_tokens,
+        hidden) and UE8M0 scales in the 128x4 swizzled layout with zeroed
+        padding rows; with ``mxfp8=False``, the BF16 normed activation and
+        None.
+
+    """
+    assert x.dim() == 2 and x.stride(1) == 1, x.shape
+    assert weight.is_contiguous()
+    assert residual is None or (residual.shape == x.shape and residual.stride(1) == 1)
+    M, H = x.shape
+    sf = None
+    if mxfp8:
+        padded_m = round_up(M, SF_ROW_TILE)
+        out = torch.empty((M, H), dtype=torch.uint8, device=x.device)
+        sf = torch.empty(
+            padded_m * round_up(H // MXFP8_BLOCK, 4), dtype=torch.uint8, device=x.device
+        )
+        if M == 0:
+            return out.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn), sf
+    else:
+        padded_m = M
+        out = torch.empty((M, H), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=x.device)
+        if M == 0:
+            return out, None
+    _gemma_rmsnorm_mxfp8_kernel[(padded_m,)](
+        x,
+        residual,
+        weight,
+        out,
+        sf,
+        M,
+        x.stride(0),
+        residual.stride(0) if residual is not None else x.stride(0),
+        eps,
+        H=H,
+        launch_pdl=current_platform.is_arch_support_pdl(),
+        num_warps=4,
+    )
+    if mxfp8:
+        return out.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn), sf
+    return out, None
