+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Host side of the Muse Spark monokernel (``--monokernel``).
+
+The guards run on real vLLM configs and on a tiny real MuseSpark1x model
+(Quark MXFP4 experts, ROCm AITER FA, a bf16 LBHNC KV cache). The FlyDSL
+launches build only for the TEP8 checkpoint shapes, so the step tests run
+them as the stock layer pieces they replace: from layer i's attention output
+to layer i+1's q, o-gate and KV insert, reading and writing the device
+memory at the pointers the host passes. A mono step must then match the
+stock layer loop: hidden states, aux hidden states and KV caches.
+"""
+
+import dataclasses
+import inspect
+import json
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import (
+    AttentionConfig,
+    CacheConfig,
+    CUDAGraphMode,
+    LoRAConfig,
+    ModelConfig,
+    ParallelConfig,
+    SpeculativeConfig,
+    VllmConfig,
+    WeightTransferConfig,
+    set_current_vllm_config,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.attention import get_attention_context
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.config import FusedMoEParallelConfig
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.model import norm_residual_then_norm
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.mono.decoder import (
+    FIRST_LAYER,
+    LAST_LAYER,
+    MonoDims,
+    MonoKernels,
+    MuseSparkMono,
+    bucket_of,
+    built_buckets,
+    collect_layer_weights,
+    config_refusals,
+    deployment_refusals,
+    fused_attention_layers,
+    kv_cache_refusal,
+    layer_refusals,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.muse_spark import MuseSparkTextConfig
+
+# The GPU tests share one tiny model and its single-rank parallel state.
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup
+
+NUM_LAYERS = 62
+ROWS_PER_REQUEST = 8
+
+# The text config of Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B (the shape the kernels build).
+CHECKPOINT_TEXT: dict[str, Any] = {
+    "model_type": "muse_spark_text",
+    "attention_bias": False,
+    "bos_token_id": 0,
+    "eos_token_id": 1,
+    "pad_token_id": 2,
+    "final_logit_softcapping": 20.0,
+    "head_dim": 64,
+    "hidden_act": "silu",
+    "hidden_size": 8192,
+    "intermediate_size": 16384,
+    "max_position_embeddings": 1048576,
+    "moe_hidden_size": 4096,
+    "moe_intermediate_size": 4096,
+    "num_attention_heads": 128,
+    "num_experts_per_tok": 8,
+    "num_hidden_layers": NUM_LAYERS,
+    "num_key_value_heads": 16,
+    "num_local_experts": 256,
+    "num_shared_experts": 0,
+    "output_multiplier": 0.17677669529663687,
+    "post_norm_eps": 1e-08,
+    "qk_scale_factor": 5.4730064863875,
+    "residual_gate_temperature": 0.3,
+    "rms_norm_eps": 1e-05,
+    "rope_parameters": {"rope_theta": 500000.0, "rope_type": "default"},
+    "routed_scaling_factor": 1.0,
+    "sliding_window": 2048,
+    "tie_word_embeddings": False,
+    "vocab_size": 202048,
+    # Full attention (and no RoPE) every 4th layer from layer 1.
+    "layer_types": [
+        "full_attention" if i % 4 == 1 else "sliding_attention"
+        for i in range(NUM_LAYERS)
+    ],
+    "layer_rope_theta": [0 if i % 4 == 1 else 500000.0 for i in range(NUM_LAYERS)],
+    "mlp_layer_types": ["sparse"] * NUM_LAYERS,
+}
+# One TP rank of the checkpoint's layout at TP = EP = 1.
+TINY_TEXT = CHECKPOINT_TEXT | {
+    "hidden_size": 512,
+    "intermediate_size": 512,
+    "moe_hidden_size": 256,
+    "moe_intermediate_size": 256,
+    "num_attention_heads": 16,
+    "num_key_value_heads": 2,
+    "num_local_experts": 8,
+    "vocab_size": 512,
+    "max_position_embeddings": 4096,
+}
+_MX_FP4 = {
+    "dtype": "fp4",
+    "qscheme": "per_group",
+    "ch_axis": -1,
+    "group_size": 32,
+    "round_method": "half_even",
+    "scale_type": "float",
+    "scale_format": "e8m0",
+    "scale_calculation_mode": "even",
+    "observer_cls": "PerBlockMXObserver",
+    "is_scale_quant": False,
+}
+
+
+def _quark_exclude(num_experts: int) -> list[str]:
+    """The checkpoint's exclusions: everything but the experts of layers 1-60."""
+    names = ["lm_head"]
+    for i in range(NUM_LAYERS):
+        layer = f"model.language_model.layers.{i}"
+        names += [f"{layer}.self_attn.{p}_proj" for p in ("q", "k", "v", "o", "gate")]
+        names += [f"{layer}.mlp.{p}" for p in ("gate", "pre_expert_proj")]
+        names.append(f"{layer}.mlp.post_expert_proj")
+        if i in (0, NUM_LAYERS - 1):
+            names += [
+                f"{layer}.mlp.experts.{e}.{p}_proj"
+                for e in range(num_experts)
+                for p in ("gate", "up", "down")
+            ]
+    return names
+
+
+def _checkpoint_config(text: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "architectures": ["MuseSparkForConditionalGeneration"],
+        "model_type": "muse_spark",
+        "dtype": "bfloat16",
+        "image_token_id": 500,
+        "audio_token_id": 501,
+        "video_token_id": 502,
+        "projector_hidden_act": "gelu",
+        "projector_hidden_size": 64,
+        "out_hidden_size": 256,
+        "text_config": text,
+        "vision_config": {
+            "model_type": "muse_spark_vision",
+            "hidden_act": "gelu",
+            "hidden_size": 64,
+            "intermediate_size": 128,
+            "layer_norm_eps": 1e-05,
+            "layer_types": ["full_attention"],
+            "max_position_embeddings": 64,
+            "merge_size": 2,
+            "num_attention_heads": 2,
+            "num_hidden_layers": 1,
+            "patch_size": 14,
+            "patch_temporal": 2,
+            "pos_emb_height": 4,
+            "pos_emb_width": 4,
+            "rope_parameters": {"rope_theta": 10000, "rope_type": "axial"},
+        },
+        "audio_config": {
+            "model_type": "muse_spark_audio",
+            "conv_kernel_size": 7,
+            "depths": [1],
+            "hidden_act": "gelu",
+            "hidden_sizes": [64],
+            "mlp_ratio": 4.0,
+            "num_hidden_layers": 1,
+            "out_hidden_size": text["hidden_size"],
+            "patch_sizes": [16],
+            "rms_norm_eps": 1e-06,
+        },
+        "quantization_config": {
+            "quant_method": "quark",
+            "global_quant_config": {
+                "input_tensors": _MX_FP4 | {"is_dynamic": True},
+                "weight": _MX_FP4 | {"is_dynamic": False},
+                "output_tensors": None,
+                "bias": None,
+            },
+            "exclude": _quark_exclude(text["num_local_experts"]),
+            "layer_quant_config": {},
+            "layer_type_quant_config": {},
+            "kv_cache_quant_config": {},
+            "export": {"kv_cache_group": [], "pack_method": "reorder"},
+        },
+    }
+
+
+# The target_layer_ids of Muse-Spark-Open-DSpark.
+DSPARK_TARGETS = [13, 29, 45, 57, 61]
+DSPARK = {
+    "model_type": "muse_spark_dspark",
+    "num_hidden_layers": 2,
+    "moe": {"is_enabled": False},
+    "global_attn_cfg": [2048],
+    "layer_types": ["sliding_attention"] * 2,
+    "target_layer_ids": DSPARK_TARGETS,
+    "num_target_layers": len(DSPARK_TARGETS),
+    "markov_rank": 8,
+    "markov_head_type": "vanilla",
+    "dflash_config": {"causal": True, "target_layer_ids": DSPARK_TARGETS},
+}
+
+
+def _vllm_config(
+    target, draft=None, tp: int = 1, cache_dtype: str = "auto", **parallel
+) -> VllmConfig:
+    model_config = ModelConfig(
+        model=str(target),
+        tokenizer_mode="skip",
+        dtype="bfloat16",
+        max_model_len=4096,
+        language_model_only=True,
+        enforce_eager=True,
+    )
+    # Config-only: "mp" skips the executor's local GPU count check.
+    parallel_config = ParallelConfig(
+        tensor_parallel_size=tp,
+        enable_expert_parallel=True,
+        distributed_executor_backend="mp",
+        **parallel,
+    )
+    speculative_config = None
+    if draft is not None:
+        speculative_config = SpeculativeConfig(
+            model=str(draft),
+            method="dspark",
+            num_speculative_tokens=ROWS_PER_REQUEST - 1,
+            target_model_config=model_config,
+            target_parallel_config=parallel_config,
+        )
+    return VllmConfig(
+        model_config=model_config,
+        parallel_config=parallel_config,
+        speculative_config=speculative_config,
+        cache_config=CacheConfig(block_size=16, cache_dtype=cache_dtype),
+        attention_config=AttentionConfig(backend="ROCM_AITER_FA"),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def checkpoints(tmp_path_factory):
+    root = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("muse_spark")
+    for name, config in (("tiny", _checkpoint_config(TINY_TEXT)), ("dspark", DSPARK)):
+        (root / name).mkdir()
+        (root / name / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(config))
+    return root
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- host guards
+
+
+def test_buckets_pad_rows_up_to_the_next_build() -> None:
+    assert [bucket_of(r) for r in (8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 64, 72, 96, 104, 128)] == [
+        8, 16, 32, 32, 64, 64, 96, 96, 128, 128,
+    ]  # fmt: skip
+    assert [bucket_of(r) for r in (0, 4, 12, 136)] == [None] * 4
+    assert built_buckets(1) == [8]
+    assert built_buckets(3) == [8, 16, 32]
+    assert built_buckets(16) == built_buckets(128) == [8, 16, 32, 64, 96, 128]
+
+
+def test_kv_cache_guard_accepts_only_dense_bf16_lbhnc() -> None:
+    lbhnc = torch.empty(10, 2, 16, 128, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="meta")
+    assert kv_cache_refusal(lbhnc, 2) is None
+    lhbnc = torch.empty(2, 10, 16, 128, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="meta")
+    assert kv_cache_refusal(lhbnc.transpose(0, 1), 2).startswith("kv:stride")
+    fp8 = torch.empty(10, 2, 16, 128, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device="meta")
+    assert kv_cache_refusal(fp8, 2).startswith("kv:torch.float8")
+    block32 = torch.empty(10, 2, 32, 128, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="meta")
+    assert kv_cache_refusal(block32, 2).startswith("kv:shape")
+    assert kv_cache_refusal(torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.bfloat16), 2) == "kv:unbound"
+
+
+def test_config_guard_accepts_only_the_checkpoint_shape() -> None:
+    assert config_refusals(MuseSparkTextConfig(**CHECKPOINT_TEXT)) == []
+    assert config_refusals(MuseSparkTextConfig(**TINY_TEXT)) == [
+        "config.hidden_size=512 (kernel: 8192)",
+        "config.moe_hidden_size=256 (kernel: 4096)",
+        "config.moe_intermediate_size=256 (kernel: 4096)",
+        "config.num_local_experts=8 (kernel: 256)",
+        "config.num_attention_heads=16 (kernel: 128)",
+        "config.num_key_value_heads=2 (kernel: 16)",
+    ]
+
+
+def _moe_parallel(use_ep: bool = True, ep_size: int = 8, ep_rank: int = 3):
+    return FusedMoEParallelConfig(
+        tp_size=1 if use_ep else ep_size,
+        pcp_size=1,
+        dp_size=1,
+        ep_size=ep_size if use_ep else 1,
+        tp_rank=0,
+        pcp_rank=0,
+        dp_rank=0,
+        ep_rank=ep_rank if use_ep else 0,
+        sp_size=1,
+        use_ep=use_ep,
+        all2all_backend="allgather_reducescatter",
+        enable_eplb=False,
+    )
+
+
+def test_deployment_guard_accepts_only_tep8_with_dspark(checkpoints) -> None:
+    tiny, dspark = checkpoints / "tiny", checkpoints / "dspark"
+    tep8 = _vllm_config(tiny, dspark, tp=8)
+    assert deployment_refusals(tep8, 3, 8, _moe_parallel()) == []
+
+    tp4 = _vllm_config(tiny, dspark, tp=4, expert_placement_strategy="round_robin")
+    tp4.parallel_config.enable_expert_parallel = False
+    assert deployment_refusals(tp4, 3, 4, _moe_parallel(use_ep=False)) == [
+        "tensor_parallel_size=4 (kernel: 8)",
+        "expert parallelism off (needs --enable-expert-parallel)",
+        "expert placement round_robin",
+        "MoE layers not expert parallel",
+    ]
+
+    no_draft = _vllm_config(tiny, tp=8, cache_dtype="fp8")
+    no_draft.lora_config = LoRAConfig()
+    no_draft.model_config.enable_sleep_mode = True
+    no_draft.weight_transfer_config = WeightTransferConfig()
+    assert deployment_refusals(no_draft, 3, 8, _moe_parallel()) == [
+        "needs speculative decoding with 7 draft tokens",
+        "LoRA on",
+        "sleep mode on",
+        "weight transfer on",
+        "kv_cache_dtype=fp8 (kernel: bf16)",
+    ]
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------- the tiny model on one GPU
+
+
+def _on_gfx950() -> bool:
+    if not (current_platform.is_rocm() and torch.cuda.is_available()):
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    return on_gfx950()
+
+
+requires_gfx950 = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not _on_gfx950(), reason="MuseSpark1x on ROCm needs AITER's gfx950 kernels"
+)
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass
+class TinyModel:
+    lm: Any
+    vllm_config: VllmConfig
+    dims: MonoDims
+    refusals_before_finalize: list[str]
+    kv_specs: dict[str, Any]
+
+    @property
+    def model(self):
+        return self.lm.model
+
+    @property
+    def layers(self):

+# The launch signatures of the FlyDSL sources, up to the peer pointers.
+_K3_HEAD = (
+    "attn_o attn_g stream_pre w_o alpha_a beta_a w_pffn w_r bias w_pre w_pren "
+    "w13 w13s w2 w2s w_post w_pp w_pff alpha beta w_in w_qkvg stream_out xn_out "
+    "part_out q_out g_out k_cache v_cache slots cos_sin pos scratch epoch health tl"
+)
+_HA_HEAD = (
+    "attn_o attn_g stream_in w_o alpha_a beta_a w_pffn w_r bias w_pre w_pren "
+    "h_out ids_out sc_out scratch epoch health tl"
+)
+_HM_HEAD = "h ids sc w13 w13s w2 w2s w_post part_out scratch epoch health tl"
+_HB_HEAD = (
+    "part w_pp w_pff alpha beta w_in w_qkvg stream_out sfull_out q_out g_out "
+    "k_cache v_cache slots cos_sin pos scratch epoch health tl"
+)
+_REPLICAS = " w13r w13sr w2r w2sr eptab"
+_DESC_WORDS = 10

+def _params(head: str, world_size: int, tail: str) -> list[str]:
+    """A launch's parameters in order."""
+    return head.split() + [f"peer{r}" for r in range(world_size)] + tail.split()
+
+
+def _device_view(ptr: int, shape, dtype: torch.dtype, strides=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The device memory at ``ptr`` as a tensor, as a launch reads it."""
+    strides = strides or torch.empty(shape, device="meta").stride()
+    extent = 1 + sum((n - 1) * s for n, s in zip(shape, strides))
+    nbytes = extent * torch.empty((), dtype=dtype).element_size()
+
+    class _Memory:
+        __cuda_array_interface__ = {
+            "shape": (nbytes,),
+            "typestr": "|u1",
+            "data": (ptr, False),
+            "version": 3,
+        }
+
+    raw = torch.as_tensor(_Memory(), device="cuda")
+    return raw.view(dtype).as_strided(shape, strides)
+
+
+class StockLaunches:
+    """The FlyDSL monokernel sources, with each launch running the stock layer
+    pieces it replaces on the memory at its arguments' pointers."""
+
+    def __init__(self, model, dims: MonoDims, bnd: int) -> None:
+        self.model, self.dims, self.bnd = model, dims, bnd
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
+        self.pending: dict[int, dict] = {}
+        self.kernels = MonoKernels(
+            *(_Kernel(self, name) for name in ("k3", "k5", "k5m")), _AttnFrag()
+        )
+
+    def launcher(self, name: str, params: list[str], run):
+        signature = inspect.Signature(
+            [inspect.Parameter(p, inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_ONLY) for p in params]
+            + [inspect.Parameter("stream", inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY)]
+        )
+
+        def launch(*args, **kwargs):
+            bound = dict(signature.bind(*args, **kwargs).arguments)
+            self.calls.append((name, bound))
+            run(bound)
+
+        return launch
+
+    def _attention(
+        self, i: int, attn_o: int, rows: int, nreq: int, fused: bool
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Layer i's attention output: at ``attn_o``, or, for a fused build,
+        run here from the descriptor row at ``attn_o``."""
+        layer = self.model.layers[i]
+        d = self.dims
+        if not fused:
+            return _device_view(attn_o, (rows, d.q_rows), torch.bfloat16)
+        words = _device_view(attn_o, (_DESC_WORDS,), torch.int64).tolist()
+        md, _, kv_cache, _ = _attention_context(layer)
+        assert words[1:5] == [
+            kv_cache.data_ptr(),
+            kv_cache.stride(0),
+            md.block_table.data_ptr(),
+            md.seq_lens.data_ptr(),
+        ]
+        assert words[8] == nreq
+        q = _device_view(words[0], (rows, d.q_rows), torch.bfloat16)
+        out = _device_view(words[5], (rows, d.q_rows), torch.bfloat16)
+        out.copy_(layer.self_attn.attn(q, None, None))
+        return out
+
+    def run_layer(self, rows: int, a: dict, b: dict) -> None:
+        """Layer i from its attention output (launch ``a``) to layer i+1's q,
+        o-gate and stream (launch ``b``)."""
+        i, nreq = a["layer"], rows // ROWS_PER_REQUEST
+        d, layer, nxt = self.dims, self.model.layers[i], self.model.layers[i + 1]
+        o = self._attention(i, a["attn_o"], rows, nreq, a["fused"])
+        g = _device_view(
+            a["attn_g"], (rows, d.q_rows), torch.bfloat16, (a["g_stride"], 1)
+        )
+        stream = _device_view(a["stream"], (rows, d.hidden_size), torch.float32)
+        positions = _device_view(b["pos"], (rows,), torch.int64)
+        _, _, kv_cache, slots = _attention_context(nxt)
+        assert b["k_cache"] == kv_cache.data_ptr()
+        assert b["v_cache"] == kv_cache.stride(0)
+        assert b["slots"] == slots.data_ptr()
+        rope = nxt.self_attn.rotary_emb
+        if rope is not None:
+            assert b["cos_sin"] == rope.cos_sin_cache.data_ptr()
+
+        y = layer.after_attention(stream, layer.self_attn.back(o, g))
+        attn_input, stream_next = norm_residual_then_norm(
+            y, nxt.self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm, out_dtype=nxt.default_dtype
+        )
+        qkv, _ = nxt.self_attn.qkv_proj(attn_input)
+        q, _, _, g_next = nxt.self_attn._qk_norm_rope_kv_insert(qkv, positions)
+        streams = ["stream_out"] + (["sfull_out"] if b.get("gather") else [])
+        for names, t in ((streams, stream_next), (["q_out"], q), (["g_out"], g_next)):
+            for name in names:
+                _device_view(b[name], t.shape, t.dtype).copy_(t)
+

+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _Key:
+    S: int
+    W: int
+    next_rope: bool = True
+    attn: str = ""
+    bnd: int = 0
+
+
+class _Kernel:
+    """One FlyDSL source module: its layouts and builds."""
+
+    BLOCKS = 4
+    HEALTH_WORDS = 8 + 8 * BLOCKS
+    TL_POINTS = 4
+
+    def __init__(self, owner: StockLaunches, name: str) -> None:
+        self.owner, self.name = owner, name
+
+    def peer_layout(self, S, W, bnd=0):
+        return {}, 4096
+
+    def scratch_layout(self, S, W=1, bnd=0):
+        return {}, 4096
+
+    def build_vllm(self, S, W, next_rope=True, attn=""):
+        return _Key(S, W, next_rope, attn, self.owner.bnd if self.name == "k5" else 0)
+
+    def build(self, key: _Key):
+        o, w = self.owner, key.W
+        if self.name == "k3":
+            params = _params(_K3_HEAD, w, "layer rank g_stride" + _REPLICAS)
+            return o.launcher("k3", params, lambda a: _run_k3(o, key, a))
+        if self.name == "k5m":
+            params = _params(_HM_HEAD, w, "layer rank nrows" + _REPLICAS)
+            return o.launcher("hm", params, lambda a: None)
+        ha = _params(_HA_HEAD, w, "layer rank g_stride s_full nrows")
+        hb = _params(_HB_HEAD, w, "layer rank so_stride so_off gather nrows")
+
+        def run_ha(a):
+            o.pending[a["layer"]] = a | {"fused": bool(key.attn)}
+
+        return (
+            o.launcher("ha", ha, run_ha),
+            o.launcher("hb", hb, lambda a: _run_hb(o, key, a)),
+        )
+
+
+class _AttnFrag:
+    TABLE_ROWS = 64
+    DESC_WORDS = _DESC_WORDS
+    VLLM_MAX_KEYS = 1 << 20
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def part_bytes() -> int:
+        return 4096
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def vllm_desc(q, kv_cache, block_table, seq_lens, out, part, nreq, scale):
+        return [
+            q.data_ptr(),
+            kv_cache.data_ptr(),
+            kv_cache.stride(0),
+            block_table.data_ptr(),
+            seq_lens.data_ptr(),
+            out.data_ptr(),
+            part.data_ptr(),
+            block_table.stride(0),
+            nreq,
+            0,
+        ]
+
+
+def _run_k3(o: StockLaunches, key: _Key, a: dict) -> None:
+    o.run_layer(key.S, a | {"stream": a["stream_pre"], "fused": bool(key.attn)}, a)
+
+
+def _run_hb(o: StockLaunches, key: _Key, b: dict) -> None:
+    a = o.pending.pop(b["layer"])
+    assert a["nrows"] == b["nrows"]
+    o.run_layer(b["nrows"], a | {"stream": a["stream_in"]}, b)
+
+
+def _attention_context(layer):
+    return get_attention_context(layer.self_attn.attn.layer_name)

+class Step:
+    """One verify step's real attention metadata and KV caches."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tiny: TinyModel, query_lens: list[int], seed: int) -> None:
+        from tests.v1.attention.utils import (
+            BatchSpec,
+            create_common_attn_metadata,
+            dense_kv_cache_views,
+        )
+        from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa import AiterFlashAttentionBackend
+        from vllm.v1.kv_cache_layout import KVCacheLayout
+
+        device = torch.device("cuda", 0)
+        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+        seq_lens = [
+            int(torch.randint(40, 300, (), generator=generator)) + q for q in query_lens
+        ]
+        self.common = create_common_attn_metadata(
+            BatchSpec(seq_lens=seq_lens, query_lens=query_lens),
+            16,
+            device,
+            arange_block_indices=True,
+        )
+        num_blocks = int(self.common.block_table_tensor.max()) + 1
+        builder_cls = AiterFlashAttentionBackend.get_builder_cls()
+        self.names = [layer.self_attn.attn.layer_name for layer in tiny.layers]
+        self.metadata: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        self.kv_caches: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+        for kind, spec in tiny.kv_specs.items():
+            names = [
+                n
+                for n, layer in zip(self.names, tiny.layers)
+                if (layer.self_attn.attn.impl.sliding_window == (2047, 0))
+                == (kind == "swa")
+            ]
+            builder = builder_cls(spec, names, tiny.vllm_config, device)
+            metadata = builder.build(0, self.common)
+            for name in names:
+                raw = torch.zeros(
+                    num_blocks * spec.page_size_bytes, dtype=torch.int8, device=device
+                )
+                (view,) = dense_kv_cache_views(
+                    raw, spec, num_blocks, 1, KVCacheLayout.LBHNC
+                )
+                self.metadata[name] = metadata
+                self.kv_caches[name] = view
+        self.tokens = sum(query_lens)
+        self.input_ids = torch.randint(
+            0, TINY_TEXT["vocab_size"], (self.tokens,), generator=generator
+        ).to(device)
+        self.positions = torch.cat(
+            [torch.arange(s - q, s) for s, q in zip(seq_lens, query_lens)]
+        ).to(device)
+
+    def run(self, tiny: TinyModel, mode=CUDAGraphMode.NONE):
+        """MuseSpark1xModel.forward on zeroed KV caches; returns the hidden
+        states, the aux hidden states and the KV caches after the step."""
+        from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+        from vllm.v1.worker.utils import bind_kv_cache
+
+        for cache in self.kv_caches.values():
+            cache.zero_()
+        context = tiny.vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context
+        bind_kv_cache(self.kv_caches, context, [])
+        slots = dict.fromkeys(self.names, self.common.slot_mapping)
+        with (
+            set_current_vllm_config(tiny.vllm_config),
+            set_forward_context(
+                self.metadata,
+                tiny.vllm_config,
+                num_tokens=self.tokens,
+                cudagraph_runtime_mode=mode,
+                slot_mapping=slots,
+            ),
+        ):
+            out = tiny.model(self.input_ids, self.positions, None)
+        hidden, aux = out if isinstance(out, tuple) else (out, [])
+        kv = {name: cache.clone() for name, cache in self.kv_caches.items()}
+        return hidden.clone(), [a.clone() for a in aux], kv
+

+def _run_mono(
+    tiny: TinyModel, step: Step, bnd: int, buckets: list[int], mode=CUDAGraphMode.NONE
+):
+    """The step with the monokernel attached, on the stock launches."""
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+
+    launches = StockLaunches(tiny.model, tiny.dims, bnd)
+    tiny.model.mono = MuseSparkMono(
+        tiny.model,
+        launches.kernels,
+        rank=0,
+        group=get_tp_group().cpu_group,
+        device=torch.device("cuda", 0),
+        dims=tiny.dims,
+        buckets=buckets,
+        fused_attention=fused_attention_layers(
+            tiny.layers, 4096, _AttnFrag.VLLM_MAX_KEYS
+        ),
+    )
+    try:
+        return launches, step.run(tiny, mode)
+    finally:
+        tiny.model.mono.close()
+        tiny.model.mono = None

+def _assert_same_step(stock, mono) -> None:
+    (hidden_s, aux_s, kv_s), (hidden_m, aux_m, kv_m) = stock, mono
+    torch.testing.assert_close(hidden_m, hidden_s, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    for name in kv_s:
+        torch.testing.assert_close(kv_m[name], kv_s[name], rtol=0, atol=0)
+    assert len(aux_m) == len(aux_s)
+    # The stock loop blends an aux state on its own, the mono path takes the
+    # blend the next layer's input norm makes: fp32 rounding apart.
+    for a_m, a_s in zip(aux_m, aux_s):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(a_m, a_s, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)

+# Muse Spark decode monokernel (MI355X, FlyDSL)
+
+`--monokernel` for `MuseSpark1xForCausalLM` on MI355X: decoder layers 1-60 of
+a speculative verify step run as persistent FlyDSL launches, from one layer's
+attention output to the next layer's q, o-gate and KV insert. vLLM's own
+attention op runs between the launches, except where a launch runs the
+attention itself (below); layer 0, layer 61 and every step the kernels do not
+cover run vLLM's stock path.
+
+## Scope
+
+- Deployment (checked at startup; a deployment that cannot run the kernels
+  raises): gfx950 with 256 CUs, tensor parallel size 8 with
+  `--enable-expert-parallel` (linear placement, 32 experts a rank, no EPLB),
+  no PP / DP / DCP / PCP, Quark OCP-MXFP4 W4A4 experts on `AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4`
+  (shuffled weights and scales), the fused QK-norm / RoPE / KV insert,
+  `ROCM_AITER_FA` with a bf16 KV cache in the LBHNC layout (block size 16),
+  DSpark with 7 draft tokens, no LoRA, sleep mode or weight transfer, no KV
+  connector or offloading.
+- Steps (checked every forward; anything else runs stock): uniform decode
+  verify batches of 1-16 requests x 8 tokens, FULL CUDA graph or eager.
+  8 / 16 rows run K3 (S = 8 / 16); 24-128 rows run HA + HM + HB with the rows
+  padded up to S = 32 / 64 / 96 / 128 (`nrows` = the real rows).
+
+## Launches (layer i, 1 <= i <= 60)
+
+    K3  o-norm x gate, o_proj, all-reduce, attention boundary (post-attn norm,
+        gated residual, pre-FFN norm), router + pre-expert projection, top-8,
+        pre-expert norm, the local experts (gate-up, SwiGLU, down, post-expert
+        norm, weighted sum), EP all-reduce, post-expert projection, FFN
+        boundary (post-FFN norm, gated residual, layer i+1's input norm),
+        layer i+1's QKV + O-gate GEMV, QK-norm, RoPE, KV insert
+    HA  K3 up to the pre-expert norm; the residual stream token-sharded
+    HM  the local experts; the partials pushed to their owner ranks
+    HB  EP reduce, post-expert projection, FFN boundary, QKV, KV insert; the
+        stream all-gathered only where a full copy is read (DSpark aux layers,
+        layer 61)
+
+Fused attention: at 8, 16 and 24-32 rows every layer from layer 2 runs its
+verify attention at the head of K3_i / HA_i (`kernels/attn_frag.py`) instead
+of vLLM's op: split over all 256 CTAs by
+(request, kv head, key range), then merged before o_proj. It reads layer i's
+q from the previous launch, layer i's bf16 KV cache through its KV cache
+group's `block_table` (int32) and `seq_lens` (int32), the softmax scale of the
+layer's attention impl, and for sliding-window layers vLLM's window (2047, 0)
+(only blocks inside the window are read). The builds stage block ids for up
+to 1M keys a request; with a larger `max_model_len` every layer runs vLLM's
+op. 40-128 rows keep vLLM's op.
+
+## Contract with vLLM
+
+- Weights: read in place from vLLM's parameters (`kernels/` builds take
+  vLLM's layouts): QKV + O-gate rows `[q | k | v | o_gate]` per rank,
+  `o_proj`, the fp32 router with the output multiplier folded in (rows
+  `[32 r, 32 r + 32)`), `pooler` / `unpooler` row slices, the experts after
+  `shuffle_weight(layout=(16, 16))` and the scales after `e8m0_shuffle`. The
+  norm multipliers are small bf16 copies (`weight + gain_center`).
+- KV: layer i+1's `kv_cache` `[block][kv head][16 tokens][K 64 | V 64]` bf16
+  and its group's `slot_mapping` (`slot < 0` = graph padding, skipped); the
+  block stride is a launch argument.
+- Fused attention: one descriptor table a build and step shape (10 words a
+  layer: q, KV cache and block stride, block table and row stride, seq_lens,
+  output, scratch, request count, scale). Tables are keyed by their contents
+  and written once (a pinned-buffer copy when first seen during graph capture).
+- q leaves without the QK scale: vLLM's attention applies
+  `0.125 * qk_scale_factor` as its softmax scale.
+- Peers: one `cudaMalloc` buffer a rank and build, opened by every rank through
+  IPC handles exchanged on the TP CPU group (plain device memory, not the
+  uncached custom all-reduce buffers). Buffers are allocated at load time and
+  every launch argument is a fixed pointer, so the launches are captured in
+  vLLM's FULL graphs.
+- Health: a wait on a peer rank times out instead of hanging and leaves a
+  record in the build's health words; `compute_logits` copies them back
+  asynchronously every 64 steps and raises on a timeout.
+
+## Numerics
+
+The kernels keep the MoE activations in bf16 (MXFP4 weights x bf16
+activations). The stock W4A4 path quantizes the expert inputs and the SwiGLU
+output to MXFP4, so `--monokernel` outputs differ from the stock path (and
+prefill, which runs stock, uses W4A4). Other differences are reduction order
+(router, GEMVs, all-reduces in rank order) and the bf16 norm multipliers.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""FlyDSL decode monokernel for MuseSpark1x on MI355X (``--monokernel``)."""
+
+import importlib
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from .decoder import (
+    FIRST_LAYER,
+    LAST_LAYER,
+    NUM_CUS,
+    MonoDims,
+    MonoKernels,
+    MuseSparkMono,
+    _routed_experts,
+    built_buckets,
+    config_refusals,
+    deployment_refusals,
+    fused_attention_layers,
+    layer_refusals,
+)
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _ensure_writable_flydsl_cache() -> None:
+    """AITER points FlyDSL at its bundled, read-only cache; new kernels need a
+    writable one."""
+    cur = os.environ.get("FLYDSL_RUNTIME_CACHE_DIR")
+    if cur and os.access(cur, os.W_OK):
+        return
+    path = Path.home() / ".flydsl" / "cache"
+    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    os.environ["FLYDSL_RUNTIME_CACHE_DIR"] = str(path)
+
+
+def _load_kernels() -> tuple[MonoKernels | None, str | None]:
+    _ensure_writable_flydsl_cache()
+    try:
+        modules = {
+            name: importlib.import_module(f"{__name__}.kernels.{name}")
+            for name in ("k3", "k5", "k5m", "attn_frag")
+        }
+    except ImportError as e:
+        return None, f"needs FlyDSL and AITER's FlyDSL helpers ({e})"
+    return MonoKernels(**modules), None
+
+
+def static_refusals(lm: nn.Module, tp_rank: int, tp_size: int) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason this deployment cannot run the monokernel; empty = supported."""
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return ["not ROCm"]
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    reasons = [] if on_gfx950() else ["not gfx950"]
+    cus = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(
+        torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+    ).multi_processor_count
+    if cus != NUM_CUS:
+        reasons.append(f"{cus} CUs (kernel: {NUM_CUS})")
+    text_config = lm.vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+    reasons += config_refusals(text_config)
+    if reasons:
+        return reasons
+    experts = _routed_experts(lm.model.layers[FIRST_LAYER])
+    moe_parallel = getattr(
+        getattr(experts, "moe_config", None), "moe_parallel_config", None
+    )
+    reasons = deployment_refusals(lm.vllm_config, tp_rank, tp_size, moe_parallel)
+    return reasons or layer_refusals(
+        lm.model, MonoDims.from_config(text_config, tp_size)
+    )
+
+
+def maybe_attach_mono(lm: nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Attach the monokernel to ``lm.model`` after the weights are final.
+
+    Collective over the TP group: every rank calls it. A deployment that any
+    rank cannot run raises on every rank, with every reason of this rank.
+    """
+    if not lm.vllm_config.kernel_config.monokernel:
+        return
+    model = lm.model
+    if model.mono is not None:
+        model.mono.refresh_weights(model)
+        return
+    group = get_tp_group()
+    rank, world_size = group.rank_in_group, group.world_size
+    text_config = lm.vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+    reasons = static_refusals(lm, rank, world_size)
+    kernels = None
+    if not reasons:
+        kernels, missing = _load_kernels()
+        if missing is not None:
+            reasons.append(missing)
+    verdict = torch.tensor([0 if reasons else 1], dtype=torch.int32)
+    dist.all_reduce(verdict, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group.cpu_group)
+    if int(verdict.item()) == 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "--monokernel: Muse Spark cannot run the monokernel: "
+            + ("; ".join(reasons) or "a peer rank refused the deployment")
+        )
+    assert kernels is not None
+    buckets = built_buckets(lm.vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs)
+    max_model_len = lm.vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len
+    fused = fused_attention_layers(
+        model.layers, max_model_len, kernels.attn_frag.VLLM_MAX_KEYS
+    )
+    if not fused:
+        logger.info(
+            "Muse Spark monokernel: verify attention unfused (max_model_len %d, "
+            "fused builds cover %d)",
+            max_model_len,
+            kernels.attn_frag.VLLM_MAX_KEYS,
+        )
+    model.mono = MuseSparkMono(
+        model,
+        kernels,
+        rank=rank,
+        group=group.cpu_group,
+        device=torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index()),
+        dims=MonoDims.from_config(text_config, world_size),
+        buckets=buckets,
+        fused_attention=fused,
+    )
+    logger.info(
+        "Muse Spark monokernel attached: layers %d-%d of verify steps with "
+        "up to %d rows run as FlyDSL launches (builds S=%s; MoE activations "
+        "in bf16)",
+        FIRST_LAYER,
+        LAST_LAYER,
+        buckets[-1],
+        ",".join(map(str, buckets)),
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = ["MuseSparkMono", "maybe_attach_mono"]

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""MuseSpark1x decode monokernel: layers 1-60 of a verify step as FlyDSL launches.
+
+See README.md. Every rank must take the same path (the kernel waits on its
+peers), so the decision uses only rank-invariant data: the static deployment
+checked at attach, the batch shape and the attention metadata counts.
+"""
+
+import dataclasses
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from types import ModuleType
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.attention import get_attention_context
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.layers import (
+    MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection,
+    MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale,
+    norm_then_gated_residual,
+)
+
+from ..muse_moe_runner import MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE
+from .peer import PeerBuffer
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+FIRST_LAYER = 1
+LAST_LAYER = 60
+ROWS_PER_REQUEST = 8
+K3_ROWS = (8, 16)
+K5_ROWS = (32, 64, 96, 128)
+WORLD_SIZE = 8
+NUM_CUS = 256
+KV_BLOCK_SIZE = 16
+HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL = 64
+# Attention types whose verify attention runs inside the launch, per build.
+# Other builds and layer 1 run vLLM's attention op.
+FUSED_ATTENTION = {8: ("swa", "full"), 16: ("swa", "full"), 32: ("swa", "full")}
+SLIDING_WINDOW = (2047, 0)
+
+# The model shape the K3 build is specialized for.
+KERNEL_CONFIG: dict[str, float] = {
+    "hidden_size": 8192,
+    "moe_hidden_size": 4096,
+    "moe_intermediate_size": 4096,
+    "num_local_experts": 256,
+    "num_experts_per_tok": 8,
+    "head_dim": 64,
+    "num_attention_heads": 128,
+    "num_key_value_heads": 16,
+    "num_hidden_layers": 62,
+    "routed_scaling_factor": 1.0,
+    "rms_norm_eps": 1e-5,
+    "post_norm_eps": 1e-8,
+    "residual_gate_temperature": 0.3,
+}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MonoDims:
+    """Per-rank tensor sizes of a TP = EP rank."""
+
+    world_size: int
+    hidden_size: int
+    pooled_size: int
+    intermediate_size: int
+    num_experts: int
+    num_heads: int
+    num_kv_heads: int
+    head_dim: int
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_config(cls, config: Any, world_size: int) -> "MonoDims":
+        return cls(
+            world_size=world_size,
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            pooled_size=config.moe_hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=config.moe_intermediate_size,
+            num_experts=config.num_local_experts,
+            num_heads=config.num_attention_heads,
+            num_kv_heads=config.num_key_value_heads,
+            head_dim=config.head_dim,
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def local_experts(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_experts // self.world_size
+
+    @property
+    def local_kv_heads(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_kv_heads // self.world_size
+
+    @property
+    def q_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_heads // self.world_size * self.head_dim
+
+    @property
+    def kv_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.local_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+
+    @property
+    def qkvg_rows(self) -> int:
+        return 2 * self.q_rows + 2 * self.kv_rows
+
+    def expert_shapes(self) -> dict[str, tuple[int, ...]]:
+        """MXFP4 expert tensors of the local experts, as uint8."""
+        e, h, i = self.local_experts, self.pooled_size, self.intermediate_size
+        return {
+            "w13_weight": (e, 2 * i, h // 2),
+            "w13_weight_scale": (e, 2 * i, h // 32),
+            "w2_weight": (e, h, i // 2),
+            "w2_weight_scale": (e, h, i // 32),
+        }
+
+
+def bucket_of(rows: int) -> int | None:
+    """The kernel build that serves ``rows`` (padded up); None = stock."""
+    if rows <= 0 or rows % ROWS_PER_REQUEST:
+        return None
+    if rows in K3_ROWS:
+        return rows
+    return next((s for s in K5_ROWS if rows <= s), None)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class LayerWeights:
+    """Views of vLLM's parameters (and small norm copies) for layer i's launches."""

+    w_o: torch.Tensor
+    alpha_a: torch.Tensor
+    beta_a: torch.Tensor
+    w_pffn: torch.Tensor
+    w_r: torch.Tensor
+    bias: torch.Tensor
+    w_pre: torch.Tensor
+    w_pren: torch.Tensor
+    w13: torch.Tensor
+    w13s: torch.Tensor
+    w2: torch.Tensor
+    w2s: torch.Tensor
+    w_post: torch.Tensor
+    w_pp: torch.Tensor
+    w_pff: torch.Tensor
+    alpha: torch.Tensor
+    beta: torch.Tensor
+    w_in: torch.Tensor
+    w_qkvg: torch.Tensor
+    next_rope: bool
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:

+            return tuple(getattr(self, n).data_ptr() for n in names.split())

+        # HA (and K3): attention boundary, router and pre-expert projection;
+        # HM: the local experts; HB: post-expert projection, FFN boundary and

+
+def effective_norm_weight(norm: nn.Module) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The bf16 multiplier the kernel applies: ``weight (+ gain_center)``."""
+    weight = norm.weight.detach().float()
+    if norm.zero_centered_gamma:
+        weight = weight + norm.gain_center
+    return weight.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()
+
+
+def _routed_experts(layer: nn.Module) -> nn.Module | None:
+    experts = getattr(layer.feed_forward, "experts", None)
+    return getattr(experts, "routed_experts", None)
+
+

+    return t.detach()[rank * n : (rank + 1) * n]

+    layers: Sequence[nn.Module], i: int, rank: int, dims: MonoDims
+) -> LayerWeights:
+    """Layer i's kernel weights from decoder layers ``i`` and ``i + 1``; no copy."""
+    layer, nxt = layers[i], layers[i + 1]
+    moe = layer.feed_forward
+    experts = _routed_experts(layer)
+    assert experts is not None
+    w = dims.world_size
+    return LayerWeights(
+        w_o=layer.self_attn.o_proj.weight.detach(),
+        alpha_a=layer.add_attn.alpha,
+        beta_a=layer.add_attn.beta,
+        w_pffn=effective_norm_weight(layer.pre_ffn_norm),
+        w_r=_rows(moe.router.weight, rank, dims.num_experts // w),
+        bias=moe.expert_bias,
+        w_pre=_rows(moe.pooler.weight, rank, dims.pooled_size // w),
+        w_pren=effective_norm_weight(moe.pre_expert_norm),
+        w13=experts.w13_weight.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w13s=experts.w13_weight_scale.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w2=experts.w2_weight.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w2s=experts.w2_weight_scale.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w_post=effective_norm_weight(moe.post_expert_norm),
+        w_pp=_rows(moe.unpooler.weight, rank, dims.hidden_size // w),
+        w_pff=effective_norm_weight(layer.post_ffn_norm),
+        alpha=layer.add_ffn.alpha,
+        beta=layer.add_ffn.beta,
+        w_in=effective_norm_weight(nxt.self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm),
+        w_qkvg=nxt.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight.detach(),
+        next_rope=nxt.self_attn.rotary_emb is not None,
+    )
+
+
+def config_refusals(config: Any) -> list[str]:
+    reasons = []
+    for name, want in KERNEL_CONFIG.items():
+        got = getattr(config, name, None)
+        if not isinstance(got, (int, float)) or abs(got - want) > 1e-12 * max(
+            1.0, abs(want)
+        ):
+            reasons.append(f"config.{name}={got} (kernel: {want})")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def deployment_refusals(
+    vllm_config: Any, tp_rank: int, tp_size: int, moe_parallel: Any
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Parallel layout and server features the monokernel does not support."""
+    reasons = []
+    parallel = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    if tp_size != WORLD_SIZE:
+        reasons.append(f"tensor_parallel_size={tp_size} (kernel: {WORLD_SIZE})")
+    for name in (
+        "pipeline_parallel_size",
+        "data_parallel_size",
+        "decode_context_parallel_size",
+        "prefill_context_parallel_size",
+    ):
+        if getattr(parallel, name, 1) != 1:
+            reasons.append(f"{name}={getattr(parallel, name)}")
+    if not parallel.enable_expert_parallel:
+        reasons.append("expert parallelism off (needs --enable-expert-parallel)")
+    if parallel.enable_eplb:
+        reasons.append("EPLB on")
+    if parallel.expert_placement_strategy != "linear":
+        reasons.append(f"expert placement {parallel.expert_placement_strategy}")
+    if moe_parallel is None or not moe_parallel.use_ep:
+        reasons.append("MoE layers not expert parallel")
+    elif moe_parallel.ep_size != tp_size or moe_parallel.ep_rank != tp_rank:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"EP rank {moe_parallel.ep_rank}/{moe_parallel.ep_size} "
+            f"!= TP rank {tp_rank}/{tp_size}"
+        )
+    spec = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    if spec is None or spec.num_speculative_tokens != ROWS_PER_REQUEST - 1:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"needs speculative decoding with {ROWS_PER_REQUEST - 1} draft tokens"
+        )
+    if vllm_config.lora_config is not None:
+        reasons.append("LoRA on")
+    if vllm_config.model_config.enable_sleep_mode:
+        reasons.append("sleep mode on")
+    if vllm_config.weight_transfer_config is not None:
+        reasons.append("weight transfer on")
+    if vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None:
+        reasons.append("KV connector on")
+    cache = vllm_config.cache_config
+    if getattr(cache, "kv_offloading_size", None):
+        reasons.append("KV offloading on")
+    if cache.cache_dtype not in ("auto", "bfloat16"):
+        reasons.append(f"kv_cache_dtype={cache.cache_dtype} (kernel: bf16)")
+    if vllm_config.model_config.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        reasons.append(f"model dtype {vllm_config.model_config.dtype}")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def _shape(t: torch.Tensor | None) -> tuple[int, ...] | None:
+    return None if t is None else tuple(t.shape)
+
+
+def layer_refusals(model: nn.Module, dims: MonoDims) -> list[str]:
+    """Module and tensor guards for layers FIRST_LAYER .. LAST_LAYER + 1."""
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    if getattr(model, "residual_dtype", None) != torch.float32:
+        reasons.append("residual dtype not fp32")
+    if not getattr(model, "fuse_across_layers", False):
+        reasons.append("layer fusion off")
+    layers = model.layers
+    if len(layers) != LAST_LAYER + 2:
+        return reasons + [f"{len(layers)} layers"]
+    bad = reasons.append
+    h, p = dims.hidden_size, dims.pooled_size
+
+    def check_bf16(i: int, name: str, w: torch.Tensor, shape: tuple) -> None:
+        if _shape(w) != shape or w.dtype != torch.bfloat16 or not w.is_contiguous():
+            bad(f"layer {i}: {name} {_shape(w)} {w.dtype}")
+
+    for i in range(FIRST_LAYER, LAST_LAYER + 2):
+        layer, attn = layers[i], layers[i].self_attn
+        if not (
+            attn.use_qk_norm
+            and attn.use_o_norm
+            and attn.use_o_gate
+            and attn.fuse_o_norm_gate
+            and attn.fused_qk_norm_rope_kv_insert
+        ) or getattr(attn, "use_attn_temperature_tuning", False):
+            bad(f"layer {i}: attention options (needs the fused KV insert)")
+        backend = getattr(getattr(attn.attn, "attn_backend", None), "__name__", None)
+        if backend != "AiterFlashAttentionBackend":
+            bad(f"layer {i}: attention backend {backend}")
+        check_bf16(i, "qkv_proj", attn.qkv_proj.weight, (dims.qkvg_rows, h))
+        rope = attn.rotary_emb
+        if rope is not None and (
+            rope.cos_sin_cache.dtype != torch.float32
+            or rope.cos_sin_cache.shape[-1] != dims.head_dim
+            or rope.rotary_dim != dims.head_dim
+            or rope.is_neox_style
+        ):
+            bad(f"layer {i}: RoPE cache {_shape(rope.cos_sin_cache)}")
+        if not layer.self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm.has_weight:
+            bad(f"layer {i}: weightless pre_qkv_proj_norm")
+        if i > LAST_LAYER:
+            continue
+        check_bf16(i, "o_proj", attn.o_proj.weight, (h, dims.q_rows))
+        for name in ("add_attn", "add_ffn"):
+            conn = getattr(layer, name)
+            if not isinstance(
+                conn, MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection
+            ) or not getattr(conn, "_coefficients_ready", False):
+                bad(f"layer {i}: {name} coefficients not materialized")
+        if layer.post_attn_norm.has_weight:
+            bad(f"layer {i}: post_attn_norm has a weight")
+        if not isinstance(layer.post_ffn_norm, MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale):
+            bad(f"layer {i}: post_ffn_norm type")
+        if not getattr(layer, "is_moe_layer", False):
+            bad(f"layer {i}: dense FFN")
+            continue
+        moe = layer.feed_forward
+        r = moe.router.weight
+        if _shape(r) != (dims.num_experts, h) or r.dtype != torch.float32:
+            bad(f"layer {i}: router {_shape(r)} {r.dtype}")
+        if moe.router_output_multiplier is not None and not getattr(
+            moe, "_router_multiplier_folded", False
+        ):
+            bad(f"layer {i}: router multiplier not folded")
+        check_bf16(i, "pooler", moe.pooler.weight, (p, h))
+        check_bf16(i, "unpooler", moe.unpooler.weight, (h, p))
+        experts = _routed_experts(layer)
+        if experts is None or not isinstance(
+            getattr(experts, "quant_method", None), MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE
+        ):
+            bad(f"layer {i}: experts not MXFP4 W4A4")
+            continue
+        for name, want in dims.expert_shapes().items():
+            t = getattr(experts, name)
+            if _shape(t) != want or t.element_size() != 1 or not t.is_contiguous():
+                bad(f"layer {i}: {name} {_shape(t)} {t.dtype}")
+        if not (
+            getattr(experts.w13_weight, "is_shuffled", False)
+            and getattr(experts.w2_weight, "is_shuffled", False)
+        ):
+            bad(f"layer {i}: expert weights not shuffled")
+        for e_n in (2 * dims.intermediate_size, dims.pooled_size):
+            if dims.local_experts * e_n % 256:
+                bad(f"layer {i}: padded scale shuffle ({dims.local_experts} x {e_n})")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def kv_cache_refusal(kv_cache: torch.Tensor, kv_heads: int) -> str | None:
+    """K3 writes bf16 LBHNC pages: ``[block][kv head][16 tokens][K | V]``."""
+    if kv_cache.numel() == 0:
+        return "kv:unbound"
+    if kv_cache.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        return f"kv:{kv_cache.dtype}"
+    want_shape = (kv_heads, KV_BLOCK_SIZE, 2 * 64)
+    if tuple(kv_cache.shape[1:]) != want_shape:
+        return f"kv:shape{tuple(kv_cache.shape)}"
+    if tuple(kv_cache.stride()[1:]) != (KV_BLOCK_SIZE * 128, 128, 1):
+        return f"kv:stride{tuple(kv_cache.stride())}"
+    return None
+
+
+def attention_type(layer: nn.Module) -> str | None:
+    """``"swa"`` / ``"full"`` when the fused attention can run layer's
+    attention (vLLM's ``sliding_window`` (2047, 0) or none); else None."""
+    window = getattr(
+        getattr(layer.self_attn.attn, "impl", None), "sliding_window", None
+    )
+    if window == SLIDING_WINDOW:
+        return "swa"
+    if window in (None, (-1, -1)):
+        return "full"
+    return None
+
+
+def fused_attention_layers(
+    layers: Sequence[nn.Module], max_model_len: int, max_keys: int
+) -> dict[int, str]:
+    """Layers whose attention the launches can fuse: ``{i: type}``.
+
+    Empty when a request may hold more keys than a build stages block ids for.
+    """
+    if max_model_len > max_keys:
+        return {}
+    fused = {}
+    for i in range(FIRST_LAYER + 1, LAST_LAYER + 1):
+        kind = attention_type(layers[i])
+        if kind is not None:
+            fused[i] = kind
+    return fused
+
+
+def batch_refusal(
+    num_tokens: int, forward_context: Any, layer_names: Sequence[str]
+) -> str | None:
+    """Why this step runs stock, from rank-invariant data only; None = mono.
+
+    Reads the attention metadata of the kernels' layers (``layer_names``) only:
+    the dict also holds the draft model's layers.
+    """
+    if bucket_of(num_tokens) is None:
+        return f"rows:{num_tokens}"
+    mode = forward_context.cudagraph_runtime_mode
+    if mode not in (CUDAGraphMode.NONE, CUDAGraphMode.FULL):
+        return f"cudagraph:{mode.name}"
+    metadata = forward_context.attn_metadata
+    if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or not metadata:
+        return "attn-metadata"
+    seen: set[int] = set()
+    for name in layer_names:
+        md = metadata.get(name)
+        if md is None:
+            return "attn-metadata"
+        if id(md) in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add(id(md))
+        decode = getattr(md, "decode_metadata", None)
+        if (
+            getattr(md, "num_prefills", None) != 0
+            or getattr(md, "num_extends", None) != 0
+            or decode is None
+        ):
+            return "not-decode"
+        if decode.max_query_len != ROWS_PER_REQUEST:
+            return f"query-len:{decode.max_query_len}"
+        if md.num_decodes * ROWS_PER_REQUEST != num_tokens:
+            return f"width:{num_tokens}/{md.num_decodes}"
+    return None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MonoKernels:
+    """The FlyDSL kernel modules (``kernels.k3``, ``k5``, ``k5m``, ``attn_frag``)."""
+
+    k3: ModuleType
+    k5: ModuleType
+    k5m: ModuleType
+    attn_frag: ModuleType
+
+
+class _FusedAttention:
+    """The fused attention of one build: its output, scratch and descriptor
+    tables (``kernels/attn_frag.py``; row i = layer i).
+
+    A table holds pointers and counts only (q, KV cache, block table,
+    seq_lens, output, request count, scale). Tables are keyed by their
+    contents, so one is written once and never changes after a CUDA graph
+    captured a launch that reads it.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        attn_frag: ModuleType,
+        layers: dict[int, str],
+        scales: dict[int, float],
+        rows: int,
+        dims: MonoDims,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.af = attn_frag
+        self.layers = layers
+        self.scales = scales
+        self.out = torch.zeros(rows, dims.q_rows, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+        self.part = torch.zeros(
+            attn_frag.part_bytes() // 4, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        self.words = attn_frag.TABLE_ROWS * attn_frag.DESC_WORDS
+        self.device = device
+        self.tables: dict[tuple, torch.Tensor] = {}
+        # Pinned sources of the table copies captured in CUDA graphs: a pinned
+        # allocation is not allowed while a stream captures.
+        self._pinned = [
+            torch.zeros(self.words, dtype=torch.int64, pin_memory=True)
+            for _ in range(8)
+        ]
+        self._keep: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+
+    def table(
+        self, layers: Sequence[nn.Module], q_of: Any, num_reqs: int
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The descriptor table of this step; ``q_of(i)`` = layer i's q."""
+        rows = {}
+        for i in self.layers:
+            md, _, kv_cache, _ = get_attention_context(
+                layers[i].self_attn.attn.layer_name
+            )
+            rows[i] = self.af.vllm_desc(
+                q_of(i),
+                kv_cache,
+                md.block_table,
+                md.seq_lens,
+                self.out,
+                self.part,
+                num_reqs,
+                self.scales[i],
+            )
+        key = tuple((i, *w) for i, w in rows.items())
+        table = self.tables.get(key)
+        if table is not None:
+            return table
+        host = torch.zeros(self.words, dtype=torch.int64)
+        n = self.af.DESC_WORDS
+        for i, w in rows.items():
+            host[i * n : (i + 1) * n] = torch.tensor(w, dtype=torch.int64)
+        table = torch.zeros(self.words, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            if not self._pinned:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "Muse Spark monokernel: more fused-attention tables than "
+                    "pinned buffers"
+                )
+            pinned = self._pinned.pop()
+            pinned.copy_(host)
+            self._keep.append(pinned)
+            table.copy_(pinned, non_blocking=True)
+        else:
+            table.copy_(host)
+        self.tables[key] = table
+        return table
+
+    def row(self, table: torch.Tensor, i: int) -> int:
+        return table.data_ptr() + i * self.af.DESC_WORDS * table.element_size()
+
+
+class _Bucket:
+    """Launchers and persistent buffers of one kernel build (row count)."""
+
+    q: list[torch.Tensor]
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        kernel: ModuleType,
+        peer_bytes: int,
+        dims: MonoDims,
+        device: torch.device,
+        group: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.dims = dims
+        self.blocks = kernel.BLOCKS
+        self.peers = PeerBuffer(peer_bytes + 256, group)
+        self.epoch = torch.zeros(4, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self.health = torch.zeros(kernel.HEALTH_WORDS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self.timeline = torch.zeros(
+            kernel.BLOCKS * kernel.TL_POINTS, dtype=torch.int64, device=device
+        )
+        self.no_rope = torch.zeros(64, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        self.fa: _FusedAttention | None = None
+
+    def _common(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        return (
+            self.epoch.data_ptr(),
+            self.health.data_ptr(),
+            self.timeline.data_ptr(),
+            *self.peers.pointers,
+        )
+
+    def run(self, mono, layers, positions, o, g, stream, aux_layers, aux_hidden_states):
+        """Layers FIRST_LAYER..LAST_LAYER; returns layer 61's (stream, q, g)."""
+        q, fa, table = o, self.fa, None
+        if fa is not None:
+            nreq = stream.shape[0] // ROWS_PER_REQUEST
+            table = fa.table(layers, lambda i: self.q[(i - 1) % 2], nreq)
+        for i in range(FIRST_LAYER, LAST_LAYER + 1):
+            kind = fa.layers.get(i) if fa is not None else None
+            if fa is not None and kind is not None:
+                attn_o = fa.row(table, i)
+            else:
+                if i > FIRST_LAYER:
+                    o = layers[i].self_attn.attn(q, None, None)
+                attn_o = o.data_ptr()
+            nxt = layers[i + 1].self_attn
+            _, _, kv_cache, slots = get_attention_context(nxt.attn.layer_name)
+            rope = nxt.rotary_emb
+            cos_sin = rope.cos_sin_cache if rope is not None else self.no_rope
+            ptrs = (slots.data_ptr(), cos_sin.data_ptr(), positions.data_ptr())
+            # The kernels take the block stride (elements) in the V slot.
+            kv = (kv_cache.data_ptr(), kv_cache.stride(0), *ptrs)
+            stream, q, g = self.layer(mono, i, kind, attn_o, g, stream, kv, aux_layers)
+            if i + 1 in aux_layers:
+                aux_hidden_states.append(stream.clone())
+        return stream, q, g
+
+    def layer(self, mono, i, kind, attn_o, g, stream, kv, aux_layers):
+        """Layer i's launches; returns layer i + 1's (stream, q, g)."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+
+class _K3Bucket(_Bucket):
+    """8 / 16 rows: one K3 launch a layer."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        k3: ModuleType,
+        rows: int,
+        dims: MonoDims,
+        device: torch.device,
+        group: Any,
+        fa: _FusedAttention | None = None,
+        fused_kinds: Sequence[tuple[bool, str]] = (),
+    ) -> None:
+        w = dims.world_size
+        super().__init__(k3, k3.peer_layout(rows, w)[1], dims, device, group)
+        self.launchers = {
+            next_rope: k3.build(k3.build_vllm(S=rows, W=w, next_rope=next_rope))
+            for next_rope in (True, False)
+        }
+        self.fa = fa
+        self.fused_launchers = {
+            (next_rope, kind): k3.build(
+                k3.build_vllm(S=rows, W=w, next_rope=next_rope, attn=kind)
+            )
+            for next_rope, kind in fused_kinds
+        }
+        self.scratch = torch.zeros(
+            k3.scratch_layout(rows, w)[1] // 4 + 64, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        bf16 = torch.bfloat16
+        self.outs = [
+            {
+                "stream": torch.zeros(
+                    rows, dims.hidden_size, dtype=torch.float32, device=device
+                ),
+                "xn": torch.zeros(rows, dims.hidden_size, dtype=bf16, device=device),
+                "part": torch.zeros(rows, dims.pooled_size, dtype=bf16, device=device),
+                "q": torch.zeros(rows, dims.q_rows, dtype=bf16, device=device),
+                "g": torch.zeros(rows, dims.q_rows, dtype=bf16, device=device),
+            }
+            for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+        self.q = [out["q"] for out in self.outs]
+
+    def layer(self, mono, i, kind, attn_o, g, stream, kv, aux_layers):
+        a, out = mono.weights[i], self.outs[i % 2]
+        launch = (
+            self.launchers[a.next_rope]
+            if kind is None
+            else self.fused_launchers[(a.next_rope, kind)]
+        )
+        launch(
+            attn_o,
+            g.data_ptr(),
+            stream.data_ptr(),
+            *a.ha,
+            *a.hm,
+            *a.hb,
+            out["stream"].data_ptr(),
+            out["xn"].data_ptr(),
+            out["part"].data_ptr(),
+            out["q"].data_ptr(),
+            out["g"].data_ptr(),
+            *kv,
+            self.scratch.data_ptr(),
+            *self._common(),
+            i,
+            mono.rank,
+            g.stride(0),
+            *a.replicas,
+            stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+        )
+        return out["stream"], out["q"], out["g"]
+
+
+class _K5Bucket(_Bucket):
+    """24-128 rows: HA (attention boundary, router, pre-expert projection),
+    HM (the local experts) and HB (FFN boundary, next QKV) a layer; between
+    the launches the residual stream lives token-sharded unless the build
+    replicates it (``key.bnd``)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        k5: ModuleType,
+        k5m: ModuleType,
+        rows: int,
+        dims: MonoDims,
+        device: torch.device,
+        group: Any,
+        fa: _FusedAttention | None = None,
+        fused_kinds: Sequence[str] = (),
+    ) -> None:
+        w = dims.world_size
+        key = k5.build_vllm(S=rows, W=w, next_rope=True)
+        super().__init__(k5, k5.peer_layout(rows, w, key.bnd)[1], dims, device, group)
+        self.bnd = key.bnd
+        self.launch_a, launch_b = k5.build(key)
+        self.launch_b = {
+            True: launch_b,
+            False: k5.build(dataclasses.replace(key, next_rope=False))[1],
+        }
+        self.launch_m = k5m.build(k5m.build_vllm(S=rows, W=w))
+        self.fa = fa
+        self.fused_launch_a = {
+            kind: k5.build(k5.build_vllm(S=rows, W=w, next_rope=True, attn=kind))[0]
+            for kind in fused_kinds
+        }
+        i32, f32, bf16 = torch.int32, torch.float32, torch.bfloat16
+        self.scratch = torch.zeros(
+            k5.scratch_layout(rows, w, key.bnd)[1] // 4 + 64, dtype=i32, device=device
+        )
+        self.scratch_m = torch.zeros(
+            k5m.scratch_layout(rows)[1] // 4 + 64, dtype=i32, device=device
+        )
+        self.timeline_m = torch.zeros(k5.BLOCKS * 8, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        topk = int(KERNEL_CONFIG["num_experts_per_tok"])
+        self.h = torch.zeros(rows, dims.pooled_size, dtype=bf16, device=device)
+        self.ids = torch.zeros(rows, topk, dtype=i32, device=device)
+        self.scores = torch.zeros(rows, topk, dtype=f32, device=device)
+        self.part = torch.zeros(rows, dims.pooled_size, dtype=bf16, device=device)
+        sharded_rows = rows // w if key.bnd < 2 else rows
+        self.ts = [
+            torch.zeros(sharded_rows, dims.hidden_size, dtype=f32, device=device)
+            for _ in range(2)
+        ]

+        self.next_in: tuple[torch.Tensor, int] = (self.sfull, 1)
+        self.q = [
+            torch.zeros(rows, dims.q_rows, dtype=bf16, device=device) for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+        self.g = [
+            torch.zeros(rows, dims.q_rows, dtype=bf16, device=device) for _ in range(2)
+        ]

+            attn_o,
+            g.data_ptr(),
+            s_in.data_ptr(),
+            *a.ha,
+            self.h.data_ptr(),
+            self.ids.data_ptr(),
+            self.scores.data_ptr(),
+            self.scratch.data_ptr(),
+            *self._common(),
+            i,
+            mono.rank,
+            g.stride(0),
+            s_full,
+            nrows,
+            stream=cur,
+        )
+        self.launch_m(
+            self.h.data_ptr(),
+            self.ids.data_ptr(),
+            self.scores.data_ptr(),
+            *a.hm,
+            self.part.data_ptr(),
+            self.scratch_m.data_ptr(),
+            self.epoch.data_ptr(),
+            self.health.data_ptr(),
+            self.timeline_m.data_ptr(),

+            mono.rank,
+            nrows,
+            *a.replicas,
+            stream=cur,

+            *self._common(),

+            mono.rank,
+            self.dims.hidden_size,

+            gather,
+            nrows,
+            stream=cur,
+        )

+
+def built_buckets(max_num_seqs: int) -> list[int]:
+    """The builds a server with ``max_num_seqs`` requests can use."""
+    max_rows = min(max_num_seqs, K5_ROWS[-1] // ROWS_PER_REQUEST) * ROWS_PER_REQUEST
+    return sorted(
+        {
+            b
+            for rows in range(ROWS_PER_REQUEST, max_rows + 1, ROWS_PER_REQUEST)
+            if (b := bucket_of(rows)) is not None

+
+class MuseSparkMono:
+    """Runs decoder layers 1-60 of eligible verify steps through the kernels."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        model: nn.Module,
+        kernels: MonoKernels,
+        rank: int,
+        group: Any,
+        device: torch.device,
+        dims: MonoDims,

+        self._steps = 0

+        """Re-take the views, e.g. after a weight reload replaced parameters."""
+        self.weights = {

+            for i in range(FIRST_LAYER, LAST_LAYER + 1)

+
+    def _step_refusal(
+        self, model: nn.Module, positions: torch.Tensor, x: Any
+    ) -> str | None:
+        if not isinstance(x, torch.Tensor):
+            return "input"
+        rows = x.shape[0]
+        names = [
+            model.layers[i].self_attn.attn.layer_name
+            for i in range(FIRST_LAYER, LAST_LAYER + 2)
+        ]
+        reason = batch_refusal(rows, get_forward_context(), names)
+        if reason is not None:
+            return reason
+        if bucket_of(rows) not in self.buckets:
+            return f"rows:{rows}"
+        if positions.dtype != torch.int64 or positions.shape != (rows,):
+            return "positions"
+        for name in names[1:]:
+            _, _, kv_cache, slots = get_attention_context(name)
+            reason = kv_cache_refusal(kv_cache, self.dims.local_kv_heads)
+            if reason is not None:
+                return reason
+            if (
+                slots is None
+                or slots.dtype != torch.int64
+                or slots.shape[0] < rows
+                or slots.stride(-1) != 1
+            ):

+
+    def try_forward(
+        self,
+        model: nn.Module,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        x: Any,
+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> Any:
+        """Returns the residual stream after the last layer, or None for stock."""
+        reason = self._step_refusal(model, positions, x)
+        if reason is not None:
+            if reason not in self._fallbacks:
+                self._fallbacks.add(reason)
+                logger.debug("Muse Spark monokernel: stock step (%s)", reason)
+            return None
+        n, rows = x.shape[0], bucket_of(x.shape[0])
+        assert rows is not None
+        if n not in self._engaged:
+            self._engaged.add(n)
+            kernel = "K3" if rows in K3_ROWS else "HA+HM+HB"
+            logger.info(
+                "Muse Spark monokernel engaged: %d rows, %s S=%d", n, kernel, rows
+            )
+        layers, aux_layers = model.layers, model.aux_hidden_state_layers
+        bucket = self.buckets[rows]
+        bucket.epoch.add_(1)
+
+        y = layers[0](positions, x)
+        if 1 in aux_layers:
+            aux_hidden_states.append(norm_then_gated_residual(y))
+        from ..model import norm_residual_then_norm  # model.py imports this package
+
+        attn = layers[FIRST_LAYER].self_attn
+        attn_input, stream = norm_residual_then_norm(
+            y, attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm, out_dtype=layers[FIRST_LAYER].default_dtype
+        )
+        qkv, _ = attn.qkv_proj(attn_input)
+        q, _, _, g = attn._qk_norm_rope_kv_insert(qkv, positions)
+        o = attn.attn(q, None, None)
+        self._validate(o, g, stream)
+        stream, q, g = bucket.run(
+            self, layers, positions, o, g, stream, aux_layers, aux_hidden_states
+        )
+
+        last = layers[LAST_LAYER + 1]
+        o = last.self_attn.attn(q, None, None)
+        y = last.after_attention(stream, last.self_attn.back(o, g))
+        if LAST_LAYER + 2 in aux_layers:
+            aux_hidden_states.append(norm_then_gated_residual(y))
+        return y
+
+    def _validate(
+        self, attn_o: torch.Tensor, attn_g: torch.Tensor, stream: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> None:
+        """Check the stock layer-1 tensors the kernels read, once a row count."""
+        rows, d = stream.shape[0], self.dims
+        if rows in self._validated:
+            return
+        for name, t, dtype, cols in (
+            ("attn_o", attn_o, torch.bfloat16, d.q_rows),
+            ("o-gate", attn_g, torch.bfloat16, d.q_rows),
+            ("stream", stream, torch.float32, d.hidden_size),
+        ):
+            # The o-gate is a column slice of the QKV + O-gate output.
+            if (
+                t.dtype != dtype
+                or tuple(t.shape) != (rows, cols)
+                or not (t.stride(1) == 1 if t is attn_g else t.is_contiguous())
+            ):
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"Muse Spark monokernel: {name} is {t.dtype} "
+                    f"{tuple(t.shape)} {t.stride()}, expected {dtype} {(rows, cols)}"
+                )
+        self._validated.add(rows)
+
+    def poll_health(self) -> None:
+        """Raise if a launch timed out waiting for a peer rank.
+
+        Reads the health words with an asynchronous copy every
+        HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL calls and checks the previous copy, so the step
+        never waits for the device.
+        """
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            return
+        self._steps += 1
+        if self._health_event is not None and self._health_event.query():
+            self._health_event = None
+            for b, host in self._health_host.items():
+                if int(host[0]) != 0:
+                    records = host[8:].view(self.buckets[b].blocks, 8)
+                    stuck = records[records[:, 0] != 0][:8].tolist()
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        f"Muse Spark monokernel: rank {self.rank}, S={b}: a launch "
+                        f"timed out waiting for a peer rank {stuck}"
+                    )
+        if self._health_event is None and self._steps % HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL == 0:
+            for b, buf in self.buckets.items():
+                self._health_host[b].copy_(buf.health, non_blocking=True)
+            self._health_event = torch.cuda.Event()
+            self._health_event.record()
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        for buf in self.buckets.values():
+            buf.peers.close()

+"""The verify attention of one Muse Spark layer as a fragment of the persistent kernels: K3
+and HA run it at their head (attn = "swa" / "full"), so the layer's attention and its decoder
+work are one launch.
+
+Shapes (a TP8 rank): 16 q heads, 2 kv heads (QPK = 8), head dim 64, 8 query tokens a request,
+NR requests (K3 S8: 1, S16: 2; HA S32: 4). K / V bf16 in the layer's vLLM LBHNC cache
+[block][2][16][K 64 | V 64] (block 16); the page table is the layer group's block_table
+(int32 [NR][stride]); seq_used = vLLM's seq_lens (int32 [NR], keys incl. the 8 new ones).
+q [8 NR, 16, 64] bf16 (row stride 1024, without the QK scale); out attn_o [8 NR, 1024] bf16.
+SWA: vLLM's window (2047, 0), keys qpos - key < 2048, and only keys in the window are read
+(vLLM frees the blocks before it: their block-table entries are stale).
+
+Split (every CTA): group = (request, kv head), CPG CTAs a group; CTA j of a group takes tiles
+[lo_t + j tps, +tps) of 64 keys (tps = ceil(n_t / CPG) at run time) for all 64 rows (8 tokens x 8
+heads) of the kv head. 8 waves = 4 row quarters (16 rows) x 2 tile lanes; a step = 2 tiles.
+K / V tiles: global -> VGPR (PD steps ahead; one 64-bit block base a wave, a wave loads the 16
+keys of one block) -> LDS. S^T = K Q^T (16x16x32 bf16 MFMA, a lane holds one q row), online
+softmax (exp2 domain, the -inf -> 0 rule), O^T = V^T P^T (P^T lane-local by a key permutation
+inside the 32-key k block; V^T from LDS with ds_read_b64_tr_b16). The 2 tile lanes merge in LDS;
+the CTA writes (m, l, unnormalized o) for 64 rows (fp32, device scope) + one tagged flag.
+
+Merge: item = (group, row) -> one output row of 64 d. NR = 1: CTA 2i merges item i with 512
+threads (32 segment lanes x 16 d-quads); NR >= 2: NR / 2 items a CTA. Poll the group's flags,
+load the partials, merge (max trick) per thread, over lanes and over waves, out = o / l -> bf16
+-> attn_o and the same rows as tagged pairs (P_AO), which the consumer (K3 stage O, HA ng)
+polls directly.
+
+Descriptor (int64 words, device memory; vllm_desc): 0 q, 1 the KV cache base, 2 its block stride
+in elements (a value), 3 block table, 4 seq_lens, 5 attn_o (out), 6 part (scratch of
+part_bytes()), 7 block-table row stride (elements), 8 real requests (requests >= it are graph
+padding: no split, zero output rows, their flags still set), 9 the softmax scale x log2(e) as
+fp32 bits. A fragment's descriptor is row `layer` of a table of TABLE_ROWS rows.
+"""

+P_AO = P_IF + 16 * 128 * 8  # attn_o as tagged pairs [row][512 words]

+
+def part_bytes():
+    return P_END

+
+def default_cpg(NR, swa):
+    g = NR * HKV
+    if swa:
+        return min(BLOCKS // g, 17)  # 2 tiles a CTA (34 tiles at most in the window)
+    return BLOCKS // g

+def make(NR, swa, maxk=VLLM_MAX_KEYS):
+    """The fragment for NR requests; swa = SWA (window 2048) or full attention. It stages enough
+    page ids a CTA for maxk keys a request (PGN)."""

+    @fx.struct

+    def fmax(a, b):

+    def fadd(a, b):

+    def p64(dv, i):

+
+Adapted from ATOM's ``atom/mono/device`` (ops.py, sync.py; MIT, AMD). Differences
+from ATOM that matter:

+* Mailbox tags are epoch based (``tag = epoch * 64 + slot + 1`` with the epoch a

+  zero-at-step-start discipline: nothing is ever zeroed.

+            sel = (keys[x_][i] > th[x_]) | ((keys[x_][i] == th[x_]) & (eq_rank < need))
+            selb = ballot(sel)
+            pos = sel_before + lanes_below(selb, lane)
+            if sel:
+                fx.ptr_store(keys[x_][i].bitcast(fx.Int32), sel_base + pos * 3)
+                fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(lane + 64 * i), sel_base + (pos * 3 + 1))
+                fx.ptr_store(sigs[x_][i].bitcast(fx.Int32), sel_base + (pos * 3 + 2))
+            eq_before = eq_before + popcount(eqb)
+            sel_before = sel_before + popcount(selb)
+    q = fx.min(lane, TOPK - 1)
+    mks, mes, mss, ranks = [], [], [], []
+    for x_ in range_constexpr(T_):
+        sel_base = rt["sel"] + tkns[x_] * (TOPK * 3)
+        mk = fx.Uint32(fx.ptr_load(sel_base + q * 3))
+        me = fx.ptr_load(sel_base + (q * 3 + 1))
+        ms = fx.ptr_load(sel_base + (q * 3 + 2)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+        rank_ = fx.Int32(0)
+        for j in range_constexpr(TOPK):
+            ok = fx.Uint32(fx.ptr_load(sel_base + j * 3))
+            oe = fx.ptr_load(sel_base + (j * 3 + 1))
+            before = (ok > mk) | ((ok == mk) & (oe < me))
+            rank_ = rank_ + before.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
+        mks.append(mk)
+        mes.append(me)
+        mss.append(ms)
+        ranks.append(rank_)

+    for x_ in range_constexpr(T_):
